title: Israeli settlers set fire to Palestinian home while family asleep
english: Israeli settlers recently set fire to a Palestinian home in the West Bank while a mother and her children were sleeping inside. This act of violence is part of a growing trend of attacks against Palestinians in the occupied territories. Human rights organizations are expressing deep concern that such incidents threaten the safety and survival of many local communities.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በምዕራብ ባንክ ውስጥ የምትገኝ አንዲት ፍልስጤማዊት እናት እና ልጆቿ ተኝተው እያሉ ቤታቸውን አቃጥለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በተያዙት ግዛቶች ውስጥ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እየተፈጸመ ካለው የጥቃት ማዕበል አንዱ ነው። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የብዙ የአካባቢው ማህበረሰቦችን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Warra Israa'el irraa dhufan kanneen naannoo weerarame irratti qubatan, mana maatii Paalastayinii tokko keessatti haatiifi ijoolleen osoo rafanii jiranu ibidda qabsiisaniiru. Gochi kun miidhaa fi doorsisa yeroodhaa gara yerootti naannoo kana keessatti Paalastayinii irratti raawwatamu keessaa isa tokko. Dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa, gochi akkasii kun jireenyaa fi nageenya hawaasa naannichaa baay'ee balaadhaaf saaxilaa akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: Europe, Canada condemn Israeli plans for new West Bank settlement
english: Several Western nations, including Canada and various European countries, have strongly criticized Israel's decision to move forward with plans for a major new settlement in the West Bank. This project, known as E1, is viewed as illegal and harmful because it would split the Palestinian territory in half and hinder future peace efforts. The international community, including the United Nations and Egypt, is calling for an immediate halt to these construction tenders to preserve the possibility of a contiguous Palestinian state.
amharic: ካናዳንና በርካታ የአውሮፓ ሀገራትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች የዓለም መንግስታት በእስራኤል የተያዘው ምዕራብ ባንክ ውስጥ አዲስ ሰፈራ ለመገንባት የተነደፈውን ዕቅድ አጥብቀው አውግዘዋል። ኢ-ወን የሚል ስያሜ የተሰጠው ይህ ግንባታ የፍልስጤምን መሬት ለሁለት በመክፈል ለሰላም ሂደት ትልቅ እንቅፋት እንደሚሆን ተገልጿል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅትንና ግብፅን ጨምሮ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ይህንን ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቆሙ እስራኤልን እየወተወቱ ነው።
oromo: Kaanaadaa fi biyyoota Awurooppaa hedduun dabalatee, mootummoonni addunyaa garaa garaa karoora Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa-Dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti manneen jireenyaa haaraa ijaaruuf qabatte cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Karoorri 'E-1' jedhamu kun lafa Falasxiin gargar kuta waan ta'eef, nagaa buusuuf yaaliin godhamu irratti gufuu guddaa ta'a jedhamee sodaatameera. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi biyyoonni akka Masrii dabalatee, sadarkaa addunyaatti qaamoleen fayyadamtoonni karoora kana yeroodhaan dhaabuun biyya Falasxiin tokko taatee akka itti fufu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
english: Israeli settlers have officially returned to the Kadim site in the occupied West Bank, twenty years after the area was abandoned. Supported by current government officials and far-right ministers, thirty families have moved back into the previously closed location near the city of Jenin. This move, which ignores international opposition, reverses a 2005 decision to dismantle the settlement and has caused significant concern among nearby Palestinian communities.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ከሃያ ዓመታት በኋላ በምዕራብ ባንክ ወደሚገኘው ካዲም ሰፈር በይፋ ተመልሰዋል። አሁን ባለው የእስራኤል መንግስት ድጋፍ፣ ሠላሳ ቤተሰቦች በጄኒን ከተማ አቅራቢያ ወደሚገኘው እና ቀደም ሲል የተዘጋው ቦታ ተመልሰዋል። ይህ ዓለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞን ችላ በማለት የተፈጸመው ድርጊት፣ እ.ኤ.አ በ2005 የተወሰደውን የሰፈራ ማፍረስ ውሳኔ የሚቀለብስ ሲሆን በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Warri qubattoota Israa'el waggoota digdamii booda naannoo Qadim kan iddoo qabatee jiru (West Bank) deebi'anii qubataniru. Mootummaan ammaa Israa'el deggarsa kennuun, maatiin soddoma ta'an magaalota Jeniin biratti iddoo kanaan dura cufame turetti deebi'aniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mormii idil-addunyaa kan tuffate fi murtoo bara 2005 godhamee ture kan jijjiire yoo ta'u, hawaasa Falasxiim naannichatti argaman biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Five missing after fire in Swiss Alpine town
english: A major fire destroyed a restaurant and its residential apartments in the Swiss town of Thusis early Friday morning. While fourteen people managed to escape the building, five others remain missing and eight individuals were hospitalized with various injuries. Authorities and firefighters were deployed immediately to handle the situation, and an investigation into the cause of the blaze is currently underway.
amharic: በስዊዘርላንድ ቱሲስ ከተማ ውስጥ በሚገኝ ምግብ ቤት እና መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ በደረሰ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ አምስት ሰዎች መጥፋታቸው ተሰምቷል። አስራ አራት ሰዎች ከህንጻው ማምለጥ የቻሉ ቢሆንም፣ ስምንት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች እና የፖሊስ ባለስልጣናት በቦታው ተገኝተው የእሳት አደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራት ምርመራ እየጀመሩ ነው።
oromo: Magaalota Siwiizerlaandi kan taate Thusis keessatti balaan ibiddaa mana nyaataa fi mana jireenyaa tokko barbadeesseera. Namoonni kudha afur ta'an balaa kana jalaa miliquu danda'anis, namoonni shan amma ammaatti bakka buuteen isaanii hin beekamu akkasumas saddeet kan ta'an miidhaa irra ga'een hospitaala galaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa fi gareen dhaamsibda ibiddaa balaa kana to'achuuf ariitiin kan socho'an yoo ta'u, sababa balaa kanaa irratti qorannoon eegalameera.

title: Australian Hussey open to Ashes Test role as England make approach
english: Former Australian cricket star Mike Hussey has revealed he received an informal job offer to become the batting coach for the England Test team. The proposal came from England's new red-ball coach, Stephen Fleming, with whom Hussey previously worked in the Indian Premier League. While Hussey has not yet made a decision, he expressed that he is open to the possibility despite acknowledging it would feel strange to coach against his home country.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአውስትራሊያ የክሪኬት ኮከብ ማይክ ሀሲ የእንግሊዝ የቴስት ቡድን የባትቲንግ አሰልጣኝ እንዲሆን መጋበዙን አስታውቋል። ጥያቄው የመጣው ከእንግሊዝ አዲሱ የአሰልጣኝ ቡድን መሪ እስጢፋኖስ ፍሌሚንግ ሲሆን፣ ሁለቱም ቀደም ሲል በህንድ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ አብረው ሰርተዋል። ሀሲ እስካሁን የመጨረሻ ውሳኔ ባይወስንም፣ ለአገሩ አውስትራሊያ ተቃራኒ ሆኖ መስራት እንግዳ ቢመስለውም ዕድሉን ግን አልዘጋውም።
oromo: Leenjisaan tapha Kirikeetii durii kan Awustiraaliyaa Mike Hussey, garee biyya Ingilizii leenjisuuf waamicha afaanin godhameef fudhachuu isaa ibseera. Waamichi kun kan dhufe leenjisaa haaraa Ingilizii Stephen Fleming irraa yoo ta'u, isaanis kanaan dura liigii Kirikeetii Indiyaa irratti waliin hojjetaniiru. Hussey hamma ammaatti murtoo dhumaa kan hin goone ta'us, biyya isaa Awustiraaliyaa irratti leenjisuun isatti xaxamaa ta'us carraa kana akka hin cufne dubbateera.

title: Dr TikTok: Mental health moves from consulting rooms to social media
english: Mental health information and advice from professionals are becoming highly popular on social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram. While this content helps bridge gaps caused by professional shortages and reduces stigma, experts warn that it cannot substitute for formal medical treatment. Users are encouraged to view these digital resources as supplementary rather than as a replacement for clinical care.
amharic: የአእምሮ ጤና መረጃዎች እና ምክሮች እንደ ቲክቶክ እና ኢንስታግራም ባሉ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መድረኮች ላይ በስፋት እየተሰራጩ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ሁኔታ በባለሙያዎች እጥረት ምክንያት የሚፈጠረውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት እና ግንዛቤን ለመጨመር የሚረዳ ቢሆንም፣ ባለሙያዎች እንደሚያስጠነቅቁት ኦፊሴላዊ የሕክምና እርዳታን ሊተካ አይችልም። ተጠቃሚዎች እነዚህን ዲጂታል መረጃዎች እንደ ተጨማሪ መረጃ እንጂ እንደ ሙሉ የሕክምና አማራጭ ሊወስዷቸው አይገባም።
oromo: Odeeffannoowwan fayyaa sammuu fi gorsi ogeeyyotaan kennamu miidiyaalee hawaasummaa akka TikTok fi Instagram irratti baay'inaan babaldhachaa jira. Kunis hanqina ogeeyyotaa guutuufi hubannoo dabaluuf kan gargaaru ta'us, ogeeyyiin akka akeekkachiisanitti tajaajila fayyaa idilee bakka bu'uu hin danda'u. Fayyadamtoonni odeeffannoowwan dijitaalaa kana akka gargaarsa dabalataatti malee, akka bakka buutuu wal'aansa kilinikaatti fudhachuu hin qaban.

title: ‘Very unusual’: UK Palestine activists could be sentenced as terrorists
english: Five activists in the UK are facing the possibility of being sentenced under terrorism laws after causing significant property damage to a Barclays bank branch in 2024. The group protested the bank's financial ties to an Israeli defense firm, but their legal team argues that applying terrorism-related sentencing is highly irregular since the group was not banned at the time of the incident. A court is expected to decide soon whether these charges will be officially applied to their upcoming September sentencing.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም አምስት አክቲቪስቶች እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 በባርክሌይስ ባንክ ቅርንጫፍ ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሳቸው በአሸባሪነት ህግ ሊቀጡ እንደሚችሉ ተገልጿል። ተከሳሾቹ ባንኩ ከእስራኤል የመከላከያ ኩባንያ ጋር ያለውን የገንዘብ ግንኙነት በመቃወም ያደረጉት ድርጊት አሸባሪነትን እንደማያካትት ጠበቆቻቸው ይከራከራሉ። ፍርድ ቤቱ እነዚህ ተከሳሾች በሴፕቴምበር ወር በሚሰጠው ብያኔ በአሸባሪነት ህግ እንዲቀጡ መደረግ አለመደረጉን በቅርቡ ይወስናል።
oromo: UK keessatti namoonni shanan tokko bara 2024 damee baankii Barclays irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiisaniin walqabatee seera shororkeessummaan himatamuu danda'u. Gareen kun baankichi dhaabbata ittisa Israa'el waliin walitti dhufeenya qabu mormuuf tarkaanfii fudhatanus, gorsitoonni seeraa isaanii seeronni shororkeessummaa akkasitti hojiirra ooluun isaa haaraa fi sirrii akka hin taane dubbatu. Manni murtii adabbii isaanii kan waxabajjii irratti murteessuuf karoorfamee jiru, himannaan shororkeessummaa kun irratti akka itti fufu ykn hin fufne murteessuuf jira.

title: Malaysia denounces Israel's E1 settlement expansion in occupied West Bank
english: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has strongly condemned Israel's plan to expand the E1 settlement project in the West Bank. He warned that this development would split the territory and severely damage efforts to establish a future Palestinian state. Furthermore, Malaysia stated it will monitor companies involved in these projects and emphasized its ongoing support for Palestinian sovereignty.
amharic: የማሌዢያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዋር ኢብራሂም እስራኤል በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የኢ-1 ሰፈራ ፕሮጀክትን ለማስፋፋት የወሰደችውን እርምጃ በብርቱ አውግዘዋል። ይህ የግንባታ እቅድ የዌስት ባንክን በመከፋፈል የወደፊቱን የፍልስጤም መንግሥት የመመስረት ተስፋ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደሚያደርስ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ማሌዢያም በእነዚህ የግንባታ ስራዎች ላይ የሚሳተፉ ኩባንያዎችን እንደምትከታተል በመግለጽ ለፍልስጤም ሉዓላዊነት ያላትን ድጋፍ ደግማ አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Maleeziyaa Anwaar Ibraahim, Israa'el naannoo weeraramee kan ta'e 'West Bank' keessatti pirojektii mana jireenyaa E1 babal'isuuf karoorfattetti mormii cimaa ibsaniiru. Ijaarsi kun lafa 'West Bank' bakka lamatti hiruu fi hundeeffama mootummaa Filisxeem gara fuulduraa irratti miidhaa cimaa akka geessisu akeekkachiisaniiru. Maleeziyaan pirojektii kana irratti kan hirmaatan dhaabbilee gara garaa akka hordoftu fi deggerree isaanii kan Filisxeemif qaban itti fufuun ibsameera.

title: Israeli shelling in Syrian Golan Height's sparks fire
english: Israeli artillery fire recently targeted agricultural land near the Syrian village of Jubata al-Khashab in the Golan Heights. The shelling, which included the use of illumination flares, caused a fire to break out on the farmland. State media reports confirmed the incident occurred in the southern part of the village.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያዎች በጎላን ኮረብታ በምትገኘው የጁባታ አል-ካሻብ መንደር አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ እርሻ ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ይህ ድብደባ እና የመብራት ቦምቦች መተኮስ በእርሻ መሬቱ ላይ የእሳት አደጋ እንዲነሳ አድርጓል። የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙሃን እንደዘገቡት ከሆነ ክስተቱ የተከሰተው በመንደሩ ደቡባዊ ክፍል ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el naannoo Golan Heightsitti argamtu gandoota Jubata al-Khashab jedhamu biratti lafa qonnaa irratti dhukaasa bananii turan. Dhukaasni kun ibiddoota ifa kennan waliin walqabatee lafa qonnaa sana irratti ibidda kaasee jira. Gabaasni miidiyaalee mootummaa akka ibsetti, miidhaan kun kan ga'e gammoojjii ganda sanaa gara kibbaatti argamu irratti dha.

title: JD Vance says US economic pressure 'most effective tool' against war on Iran
english: US Vice President JD Vance announced that the government is prioritizing economic sanctions as its primary strategy against Iran. He explained that this approach aims to increase American energy production, which would help lower fuel costs for citizens. The administration intends to maintain this strategy as the most impactful way to exert international pressure.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምትከተለው ዋና ስልት ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ማሳደር እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ አካሄድ የአሜሪካን የነዳጅ ምርት በመጨመር የሀገር ውስጥ የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመቀነስ እንደሚያግዝ አስረድተዋል። መንግስታቸው ይህንን የጫና ስልት እንደ ውጤታማ መንገድ አድርጎ እንደሚቀጥልበትም አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Itti aantuun pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa diinagdee fayyadamuun imaammata ijoo Itoophiyaa irratti hordofaa jirtu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun omisha boba'aa Ameerikaa dabaluun gatii boba'aa biyyattii gadi buusuuf gargaara jedhamee amanama. Mootummaan isaanii dhiibbaa diinagdee kana akka meeshaa cimaa tokkootti fayyadamuuf akka itti fufan ibsaniiru.

title: Ongoing Israeli air strikes, massive blasts reported in south Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces launched a series of air strikes and artillery attacks across several locations in southern Lebanon early Friday. Significant explosions were reported in the town of Mansouri, with additional military activity observed in areas including Ali al-Taher Hill, Haddatha, and Tayri. These strikes have caused widespread concern throughout the southern region as the conflict continues to intensify.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች አርብ እለት በሊባኖስ ደቡባዊ አካባቢዎች ተከታታይ የአየር እና የመድፍ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። በማንሱሪ ከተማ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች የተሰሙ ሲሆን በአሊ አል-ታሂር ኮረብታ እንዲሁም በሐዳታ እና በታይሪ ከተሞችም ተመሳሳይ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ታይተዋል። ይህ የቀጠለው ጥቃት በክልሉ ከፍተኛ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን ውጥረቱ እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganamuma Jimaataa kibba Libaanoositti haleellaa qilleensaa fi meeshaa gurguddaan bananiiru. Magaala Mansuurii keessatti dhoohaan cimaan dhaga'ameera; akkasumas gaara Ali al-Taahiri fi magaalota Haddatha fi Tayri irratti haleellaan raawwatameera. Haleellaan kun naannichatti soda guddaa uumee kan jiru yoo ta'u, waldhibdeen kunis caalaatti hammaachaa jira.

title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian man during raid in Jenin
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid in Jenin that resulted in the death of a Palestinian man named Fathi Khazem. While local health officials reported he was killed inside his residence, Israeli media claimed the shooting occurred after he allegedly tried to attack soldiers. The incident took place during an attempted arrest operation in the al-Masarwa neighborhood.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በጀኒን ባደረጉት ዘመቻ ፋቲ ካዘም የተባለ ፍልስጤማዊ ግለሰብ ተገድሏል። የጤና ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ግለሰቡ የተገደለው መኖሪያ ቤቱ ውስጥ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል ሚዲያዎች ግን ወታደሮቹን በቢላ ለመውጋት ሲሞክር እንደተገደለ ይናገራሉ። ክስተቱ የተፈጠረው ወታደሮቹ በጀኒን ከተማ ውስጥ በታቀደላቸው የመያዝ ኦፕሬሽን ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el magaalaa Jeniin keessatti tarkaanfii fudhateen Fathi Kaazem jedhamu ajjeefameera. Maddi oduu fayyaa akka ibsetti namichi kun mana isaa keessatti kan ajjeefame yoo ta'u, miidiyaaleen Israa'el garuu loltoota waraanaaf harka kennuu diduun miilaan waraana irratti yaale kan ajjeefame ta'uu gabaasaniiru. Ajjeechaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo waraanni sun nama kana qabuuf yaalii godhaa turetti dha.

title: British rapper Yung Filly to face retrial on rape charges in Australia
english: British rapper and YouTuber Yung Filly, whose real name is Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos, will face a retrial in Australia regarding three rape charges. Although a jury acquitted him of several sexual assault and violence-related offenses, they failed to reach a unanimous verdict on these specific counts. The entertainer, who was already convicted of two assault charges involving bodily harm, is scheduled to appear in court again in August.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ራፐር እና የዩቲዩብ ተጠቃሚ ያንግ ፊሊ፣ ትክክለኛ ስሙ አንድሬስ ፌሊፔ ቫለንሲያ ባሪየንቶስ፣ በአውስትራሊያ በሶስት አስገድዶ መድፈር ክሶች ላይ እንደገና ችሎት ይቀርባል። ዳኞች ከበርካታ የወሲብ ጥቃት ክሶች ነፃ ቢለቁትም፣ በተጠቀሱት ሶስት ክሶች ላይ ግን መግባባት ላይ መድረስ አልቻሉም። ቀደም ሲል በሁለት የአካል ጉዳት ጥቃት ክሶች ጥፋተኛ የተባለው ይህ ታዋቂ ሰው፣ በነሐሴ ወር እንደገና ፍርድ ቤት ይቀርባል።
oromo: Raapparriifi YouTuber-ri biyya Ingiliz Yung Filly, maqaan isaa dhugaan Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos jedhamu, himannaa gudeeddii sadii irratti dhiyaateef Awustiraaliyaatti irra deebi'ee mana murii dhiyaachuuf jira. Koreen murteessituu himannaa miidhaa saalaa hedduu irraa isa bilisa baasaniis, himannaa gudeeddii sadii irratti garuu waliigaltee irra gahuu hin dandeenye. Namni beekamaan kun kanaan dura himannaa miidhaa qaamaa lama irratti yakka qabaachuu isaa erga mirkanaa'ee booda, gara fuulduraatti gaafa Hagayyaa ammas mana murii dhiyaachuuf jira.

title: Dozens of migrants land on Spanish coast surprising beachgoers
english: A group of 62 migrants unexpectedly arrived at Cala Del Barco beach in southeastern Spain by boat, startling people who were relaxing on the shore. Spanish authorities and the Civil Guard were alerted to the situation and successfully located all the individuals involved. Social media footage captured the unusual scene as the boat landed among the beachgoers.
amharic: 62 ስደተኞች በጀልባ በደቡብ ምስራቅ ስፔን ወደምትገኝ የባህር ዳርቻ በመድረሳቸው በቦታው የነበሩትን ሰዎች አስደንግጠዋል። የስፔን ባለስልጣናት እና የሲቪል ጥበቃ ሰራዊት ስደተኞቹ መድረሳቸውን ተከትሎ በፍጥነት በመንቀሳቀስ በሙሉ ቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋቸዋል። ክስተቱ የተከሰተው ካላ ደል ባርኮ በተባለ የባህር ዳርቻ ሲሆን፣ በወቅቱ በቦታው የነበሩ ሰዎች ሁኔታውን በምስል ቀርጸው በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ አሰራጭተውታል።
oromo: Godantoonni 62 ta’an doonii xiqqoon gara qarqara galaana Cala Del Barco kan kibba-baha Ispeenitti argamu dhaqqabuun namoota bakka sana bashannana turan dinqisiiseera. Aangeyyoonni biyyattii fi poolisiin nageenyaa battalatti sadarkaa sana irra ga’uun godantoota hunda to’annoo jala oolchaniiru. Namoonni qarqara galaanichatti turan haala tasa mudate kana viidiyoon waraabuun miidiyaalee hawaasummaa irratti qoodaniiru.

title: Hong Kong Tiananmen activists found guilty of national security charges
english: Two prominent Hong Kong activists, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, have been convicted of inciting subversion for organizing annual vigils commemorating the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. The court proceedings are being criticized by rights groups as an example of declining freedom of speech in the region under strict national security laws. The pair now face potential prison sentences of up to ten years as authorities continue to suppress public memory of the historical event.
amharic: ሁለት ታዋቂ የሆንግ ኮንግ አክቲቪስቶች የሆኑት ሊ ቼኡክ-ያን እና ቾው ሃንግ-ቱንግ፣ በ1989 የተካሄደውን የቲያንሜን አደባባይ ጭፍጨፋ ለማስታወስ የሻማ ማብራት ስነ-ስርዓት በማዘጋጀታቸው መንግስትን በመፈንቀል ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ሆነዋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ይህ ፍርድ በሆንግ ኮንግ የመናገር ነፃነት እየተገደበ መምጣቱን የሚያሳይ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሁለቱ አክቲቪስቶች እስከ አስር ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊፈረድባቸው እንደሚችል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mirga namoomaa Hong Kong Lee Cheuk-yan fi Chow Hang-tung jedhaman, yaadannoo ajjeechaa bara 1989 naannoo Tiyaananmen qopheessuun isaaniif himata mootummaa fonqolchuun yakka irratti itti murtaa'eera. Murtii kanaan walqabatee gareewwan mirga namoomaa, Hong Kong keessatti mirgi yaada ibsachuu akka xiqqaachaa deeme dubbachuun balaaleeffataniiru. Namoonni kunneen amma hidha waggaa kudhanii gahuu danda'u.

title: Hamas told to be 'sensitive' to Netanyahu ahead of Israeli elections as attacks on Gaza continue
english: A senior Hamas official revealed that mediators requested the group exercise caution regarding Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political position ahead of upcoming elections. Hamas rejected this pressure, stating they are not willing to sacrifice Palestinian lives to help Netanyahu secure a political victory. Meanwhile, the group emphasized that Israel has failed to uphold its ceasefire commitments while continuing military strikes and restricting aid into Gaza.
amharic: የሃማስ ከፍተኛ አመራር እንደገለጹት አሸማጋዮች በእስራኤል ምርጫ ወቅት ለጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ጠይቀዋቸዋል። ሃማስ ይህን ጥያቄ ውድቅ በማድረግ የኔታንያሁ የፖለቲካ ድል እውን እንዲሆን የፍልስጤማውያንን ህይወት ለመሰዋት ፈቃደኛ እንዳልሆነ አስታውቋል። በሌላ በኩል ሃማስ እስራኤል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን ባለማክበር በጋዛ ላይ ጥቃቷን እንደቀጠለችና ሰብአዊ እርዳታ እንዳይገባ እያደረገች መሆኗን ገልጿል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo Haamaas akka jedhanitti, giddu-galaan dubbattoonni filannoo Israa'el dura dhimma siyaasaa muummicha ministeeraa Benyaamiin Netanyaahuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennuuf isaan gaafatanii turan. Haamaas dhiibbaa kana mormuudhaan, injifannoo siyaasaa Netanyaahuuf jecha jireenya Ummata Falasxeen aarsaa gochuuf fedhii akka hin qabne ibseera. Gama biraatiin, Israa'el waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa cabsuudhaan Gaazaa irratti haleellaa itti fufuu fi gargaarsa namoomaa daangessuu ishee Haamaas himateera.

title: El Niño set to be 'strongest in living memory', says Met Office
english: The UK Met Office warns that a developing El Niño event in the Pacific is likely to become the most powerful one ever recorded. This intense natural weather pattern, combined with human-caused climate change, is expected to make 2027 the hottest year in history. The phenomenon is already disrupting global weather, causing unpredictable rainfall and storm patterns worldwide.
amharic: የብሪታንያ ሜትሮሎጂ ቢሮ በፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ እየተከሰተ ያለው የኤል নিনዮ ክስተት በታሪክ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ ኃይል እንደሚኖረው አስጠንቅቋል። ይህ ተፈጥሯዊ የአየር ሁኔታ ለውጥ ከሰው ሰራሽ የአየር ንብረት መዛባት ጋር ተዳምሮ፣ ዓመተ ምህረት 2027 በዓለም ታሪክ እጅግ ሞቃታማው ዓመት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተገምቷል። ይህ ክስተት በአሁኑ ወቅት በዓለም ዙሪያ ባሉ የዝናብ እና የአየር ሁኔታ ዑደቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል እየፈጠረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Biroon qilleensa UK akka akeekkachiisetti, mudannoon El Nino Paasifikii keessatti uumamaa jiru kun hanga har'aatti kan mul'ate keessaa kan hunda caalu ta'uuf deema. Jijjiiramni qilleensaa kun kan namaan dhufu waliin walitti makamee, bara 2027 waggaa addunyaa irratti hunda caalaa ho'aa ta'u akka danda'u ibsameera. Mudannoon kun amma iyyuu qilleensa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jiruun, roobaa fi bubbee irratti jijjiirama hin baratamne fidaa jira.

title: Why the US economy is ringing alarm bells
english: The United States national debt has officially surpassed $40 trillion, a significant milestone that has raised concerns among economists and policymakers. This rapid growth is fueled by years of high public spending, tax cuts, and the need to fund pandemic and financial crisis recovery efforts. With interest rates currently at multi-decade highs, the cost of servicing this massive debt is becoming increasingly expensive and unsustainable for the government.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ብሄራዊ ዕዳ ከ40 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ በማለፉ በኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ይህ ዕዳ በፍጥነት እንዲያድግ ያደረጉት የመንግስት የወጪ ጭማሪዎች፣ የግብር ቅነሳዎች እና ለተለያዩ ቀውሶች ምላሽ ለመስጠት የተወሰዱ ብድሮች ናቸው። በአሁኑ ወቅት የወለድ ምጣኔ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ በመሆኑ፣ ይህንን ግዙፍ ዕዳ ለመክፈል የሚወጣው ወጪ ለመንግስት ፈተና እየሆነ መጥቷል።
oromo: Hanga idaa biyyoolessaa kan Ameerikaa tilmaama tiriliyoona 40 ga'ee jiraachuun isaa hayyoota dinagdee biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira. Daballiin idaa kanaa kan dhufe waggoota darban keessa baasii mootummaan baase, hir'ina gibiraa fi furmaata rakkoolee diinagdee addunyaa irratti hunda ta'uun isaati. Yeroo ammaa qoodni dhala baankii (interest rate) sadarkaa olaanaa irra waan jiruuf, idaa kana kaffaluun mootummaa irratti ba'aa guddaa ta'ee jira.

title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists guilty in national security trial
english: Two Hong Kong activists, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, have been convicted of subverting state power for organizing vigils commemorating the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. The pair faces up to 10 years in prison under the city's strict national security law, which has been used to silence dissent and stop public memorial gatherings. Rights groups have criticized the verdict, arguing that the activists are being unfairly targeted for peaceful actions that do not constitute legitimate crimes.
amharic: የሆንግ ኮንግ አክቲቪስቶች የሆኑት ሊ ቼክ-ያን እና ቾው ሃንግ-ቱንግ፣ የ1989 የቲያናንመን አደባባይ ግድያን የሚዘክር የሻማ ማብራት ስነ-ስርዓት በማዘጋጀታቸው በመንግስት ስልጣን ላይ ሴራ በመጠቅለል ወንጀል ተፈርዶባቸዋል። ሁለቱ ግለሰቦች በከተማዋ ተግባራዊ በሆነው ጥብቅ የብሔራዊ ደህንነት ህግ እስከ 10 ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊቀጡ ይችላሉ። ዓለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች ይህ ውሳኔ ፍትሃዊ አይደለም በማለት የሁለቱንም አክቲቪስቶች በአስቸኳይ እንዲለቀቁ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mirga namoomaa Hong Kong kan ta'an Lee Cheuk-yan fi Chow Hang-tung, yaadannoo guyyaa ajjeechaa dirree Tiananmen bara 1989 qopheessuudhaan mootummaa fonqolchuuf yaalan jechuudhaan itti murteeffameera. Namoonni kunneen seerri nageenya biyyaalessaa kan Hong Kong akka jedhutti waggaa 10 hamma ta'uuf hidhamuu danda'u. Gareewwan mirga namoomaa fi namoonni hedduun murtoon kun kanneen yaada isaanii ibsatan irratti uggura kaa'uuf kan fudhatame akka ta'e ibsuun, namoonni kunneen akka gadhiifaman gaafataniiru.

title: Pakistan’s Imran Khan moved to hospital after Supreme Court order
english: Pakistan's former Prime Minister Imran Khan has been transferred from prison to a private medical facility. This move follows a direct intervention and order from the country's Supreme Court. Mr. Khan has been serving a jail sentence for over three years.
amharic: የፓኪስታኑ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን ከእስር ቤት ወደ ግል የህክምና ማዕከል ተዛውረዋል። ይህ የተደረገው የሀገሪቱ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ባስተላለፈው ትእዛዝ መሰረት ነው። የ73 ዓመቱ ኢምራን ካን ከሶስት ዓመታት በላይ በእስር ላይ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Paakistaan duraanii Imraan Khaan mana hidhaatii gara hospitaala dhuunfaatti darbeera. Jijjiirraan kun kan raawwatame ajaja Mana Murtii Olaanaa biyyattii hordofee dha. Khaan waggoota sadii ol mana hidhaatti erga darbatamanii booda yaalama jiru.

title: Poland summons Israeli envoy over dropped probe into killing of WCK aid workers
english: The Polish government has officially summoned the Israeli ambassador to express its strong dissatisfaction after Israel closed its investigation into an airstrike that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers, including a Polish citizen. Warsaw condemned the decision to drop the probe and is demanding a full explanation regarding the tragedy. Polish officials emphasized that they will not tolerate efforts by those responsible to avoid legal and moral consequences for the deaths.
amharic: የፖላንድ መንግሥት የዓለም የምግብ ማዕከል ሰራተኞችን ገድሏል የተባለውን የአየር ጥቃት መርማሪ ቡድን እስራኤል መዝጋቷን ተከትሎ የእስራኤልን አምባሳደር በይፋ ጠርቷል። በፖላንድ ዜጋ ላይ ደረሰውን ጉዳት ጨምሮ ሰባት የሰብዓዊ ዕርዳታ ሰራተኞች ለተገደሉበት ክስተት እስራኤል የወሰደችውን ውሳኔ ዋርሶ በጽኑ አውግዛለች። የፖላንድ መንግሥት የሟቾች ጉዳይ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲጣራ እና ተጠያቂዎች ከሕግና ከሞራል ግዴታቸው ለማምለጥ የሚያደርጉትን ሙከራ እንደማይቀበሉ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Pooland gareen qorannoo Israa’el balaa xiyyaaraa hojjettoota dhaabbata gargaarsa 'World Central Kitchen' torba ajjeese irratti gaggeessaa ture cufuusaa mormuun, ambaasaaddara Israa'el waamuu ishee beeksisite. Pooland du'a lammii ishee dabalatee namoota gargaarsa namoomaa irratti argaman kana irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatame akka sirritti qoratamu gaafatteetti. Mootummaan Pooland qondaaltoonni kun itti gaafatamummaa seeraa fi amala irraa akka hin miliqne akeekkachiisuun, dhimmi kun hamma dhumaatti akka qulqullaa’u gaafatteetti.

title: Bali jails Swiss tourist for insulting sacred Day of Silence
english: A Swiss tourist has been sentenced to one year in prison for breaking rules during Bali’s sacred Day of Silence, known as Nyepi. The 26-year-old was arrested after posting an offensive video of himself walking on a beach during the holiday, which requires everyone on the island to remain indoors and quiet. While the tourist apologized and claimed he did not understand the severity of the restrictions, authorities used the sentence to emphasize the importance of respecting local customs.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ባሊ ደሴት አንድ የስዊስ ቱሪስት በቅዱሱ የዝምታ ቀን ወይም 'ኒዬፒ' ወቅት ህግ በመተላለፉ የአንድ ዓመት እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። የ26 ዓመቱ ወጣት በበዓሉ ቀን ከቤት መውጣት ክልክል ቢሆንም፣ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ሲንቀሳቀስ የሚያሳይ አሳፋሪ ቪዲዮ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመልቀቁ ነበር የታሰረው። ቱሪስቱ ድርጊቱን በመጸጸት ይቅርታ ቢጠይቅም፣ የባሊ ባለስልጣናት የአካባቢውን ባህልና ሃይማኖታዊ ክንውኖች ለማክበር ጥብቅ እርምጃ መውሰዳቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Turistiin biyya Swiizerlaand tokko guyyaa soomanaa fi calliinsa Bali ykn 'Nyepi' jedhamu kan kabajamu keessatti seera cabsee argamuun hidhaa waggaa tokkoon adabameera. Namni umuriin isaa 26 ta'e kun guyyaa sana namni hundi manatti taa'ee calliinsaan turuun dirqama ta'us, inni garuu bakka namni hin jirreetti bahuun vidiyoo gadi xiqqeessu miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti gadhiisuun isaa mufannaa uume. Turistiin kun gocha isaa irratti gaabbee dhiifama gaafatus, mootummaan Bali aadaa fi amantii naannichaa kabachiisuuf jecha tarkaanfii cimaa kana fudhateera.

title: After GERD, can Egypt shape Ethiopia’s next Nile dams?
english: Ethiopia is moving forward with plans to build three new hydropower dams on the Blue Nile following the recent launch of the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam. This development presents a fresh challenge for Egypt, which previously failed to block the earlier project through its long-standing opposition. Cairo is now focusing on diplomacy and regional cooperation to manage these upcoming projects, as the ultimate impact on downstream water flow remains uncertain.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ የታላቁ የኢትዮጵያ ህዳሴ ግድብን በቅርቡ ካጠናቀቀች በኋላ፣ በዓባይ ወንዝ ላይ ሶስት ተጨማሪ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ግድቦችን ለመገንባት እቅድ ይዛ እየተንቀሳቀሰች ነው። ይህ እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል የህዳሴ ግድብ ግንባታን ለማስቆም በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ሳይሳካለት ለቀረው የግብፅ መንግስት አዲስ ፈተና ሆኗል። ግብፅ አሁን ባላት የውሃ ፍሰት ላይ ሊኖር የሚችለውን ተፅእኖ ለመቆጣጠር ከሱዳን ጋር በመተባበር እና በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶች ላይ ትኩረት አድርጋ እየሰራች ነው።
oromo: Itoophiyaan hidha haaromsaa guddicha erga xumurte booda, harcaatii laga Abbayyaa irratti hidha elektirikii biraa sadii ijaaruuf karoorfachaa jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun biyya Gibxii kan kanaan dura hidhicha dhaabuuf yaaltee hin milkoofneef qormaata haaraa ta'ee jira. Gibxiin amma dhiibbaa hidhonnii kun bishaan laga Abbayyaa irratti geessisuu danda'an to'achuuf jecha, biyyoota ollaa waliin marii fi dipiloomasii irratti xiyyeeffachaa jirti.

title: US vows to 'collapse' Iran with new sanctions as energy prices spike
english: The United States has announced plans to impose the most severe sanctions ever against Iran in an effort to destabilize the country's government. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that these new measures, combined with an ongoing blockade, are designed to cripple the Iranian economy. President Trump also warned that any nations that provide assistance to Iran will face significant economic repercussions.
amharic: አሜሪካ የኢራንን መንግስት ለማዳከም እስካሁን ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ ማዕቀብ እንደምትጥል አስታውቃለች። የግምጃ ቤት ሚኒስትሩ ስኮት ቤሰንት እንደተናገሩት፣ አዲሱ ማዕቀብ እና በኢራን ላይ የተጣለው እገዳ የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ በእጅጉ እንደሚጎዳው ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ለኢራን ድጋፍ የሚሰጡ ማናቸውም ሀገራት ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስጠነቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ameerikaan mootummaa Iraan dadhabsiisuuf jechuun guyyoota dhufan keessatti tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa ta'e fudhachuuf karoorfattetti. Ministirri bajataa Ameerikaa Sakoottii Beesant akka ibsanitti, qophiin kun fi dhiibbaan diinagdee cimaan Iraanirratti godhamu biyyattii gadi baasuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Preezidaant Traampis gama isaaniitiin, biyyootni Iraaniif gargaarsa taasisan kamiyyuu adabbii diinagdee cimaa akka keessatti beekameef akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Brazil launches AI supercomputer push while balancing US and Chinese tech
english: The Brazilian government is investing approximately $444 million to advance its artificial intelligence infrastructure while strategically balancing partnerships with both the United States and China. Half of the funding will support a project with Chinese firms Huawei and iFlytek to develop language models, while the remainder is earmarked for a powerful supercomputer likely to be supplied by the American company Nvidia. This approach aims to boost national data sovereignty and avoid over-reliance on any single nation or technology provider.
amharic: የብራዚል መንግስት አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ መሰረተ ልማቱን ለማሳደግ ወደ 444 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ ኢንቨስትመንት አቅዷል። ሀገሪቱ ከአሜሪካ እና ከቻይና ኩባንያዎች ጋር ባላት የቴክኖሎጂ አጋርነት ሚዛኑን የጠበቀ አካሄድ በመከተል፣ የቻይናዎቹን ሁዋዌ እና አይፍላይቴክ ለቋንቋ ሞዴሎች፣ የአሜሪካን ኩባንያ ኤንቪዲያን ደግሞ እጅግ ኃይለኛ የሆነውን ሱፐር ኮምፒውተር ለመገንባት መርጣለች። ይህ ስልት ሀገሪቱ በቴክኖሎጂ ላይ ያላትን የራስ ገዝነት ለማጠናከር እና በአንድ ሀገር ላይ ብቻ ጥገኛ ላለመሆን ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Braazil damee 'Artificial Intelligence' cimsuuf investimentii tilmaamaan $444 miiliyoonaa ta'u ramadeera. Braazil michummaa biyyoota lamaan, Ameerikaa fi Chaayinaa gidduutti wal-qixxeessuuf, hojiiwwan teeknoolojii gurguddaa hiriirsiteetti. Hojiiwwan kanaanis dhaabbilee Chaayinaa Huawei fi iFlytek waliin ta'uun modeleewwan afaanii yoo gabbisan, kutaansaa hafe ammoo kompiitara guddicha 'Supercomputer' jedhamu kan Ameerikaa Nvidia irraa argachuu malu ijaaruuf oola. Adeemsi kun mootummaan Braazil biyyoota kanatti hirkattummaa xiqqeessuufi of danda'uuf kan itti fayyadamaa jirtuudha.

title: Panama Canal to limit shipping ahead of extreme weather during El Nino
english: The Panama Canal Authority is reducing daily ship transits starting in September to manage lower water levels caused by the El Nino weather phenomenon. These limits will initially cap daily traffic at 34 vessels, dropping further to 32 later in the month to conserve water resources. This move may lead to shipping delays and higher costs, as the canal is a vital route for global trade that usually supports more frequent passage.
amharic: የፓናማ ካናል ባለስልጣን በኤል ኒኖ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ምክንያት የሚከሰተውን የውሃ መጠን መቀነስ ለመቆጣጠር በሴፕቴምበር ወር መጀመሪያ ላይ የሚያልፉ መርከቦችን ቁጥር ለመቀነስ ወስኗል። የውሃ ሀብትን ለመቆጠብ ታስቦ በተወሰደው በዚህ እርምጃ፣ በየቀኑ የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ቁጥር መጀመሪያ ወደ 34፣ ከዚያም ወደ 32 ዝቅ ይላል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዓለም አቀፍ ንግድ ላይ ተጽዕኖ በመፍጠር የትራንስፖርት መዘግየትን እና የዋጋ ጭማሪን ሊያስከትል ይችላል።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa maariyaa Paanaamaa sababa jijjiirama qilleensa 'El Nino' tiin sadarkaan bishaanii waan hir'ateef, ji'a Fulbaanaa irraa eegalee lakkoofsa dooniiwwan darban murteessuuf karoorfateera. Bishaan qusachuuf jecha, dooniiwwan guyyaatti darban jalqaba gara 34, ergasii ammoo gara 32 tti gadi buusuuf murtaa'eera. Tarkaanfiin kun daldala idil-addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumee, tursiisa geejjibaa fi gatii meeshaalee dabaluu danda'a.

title: Antigovernment protesters take to Tunisia’s streets for second month
english: Protesters in Tunisia are holding ongoing demonstrations to demand the resignation of President Kais Saied and an end to his authoritarian rule. The public is frustrated by a deepening economic crisis that has caused shortages of essential goods, rising costs, and failing public services. Additionally, activists and human rights organizations have criticized the government for its harsh crackdown on political opponents, journalists, and civil society members.
amharic: በቱኒዚያ የሚገኙ ተቃዋሚዎች የፕሬዚዳንት ቀይስ ሰኢድን ስልጣን መልቀቅ እና የአንድ ሰው አገዛዝ እንዲያበቃ በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ። በሀገሪቱ የኑሮ ውድነት መባባስ፣ የቁሳቁስ እጥረት እና የመሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶች መስተጓጎል በህዝቡ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ቅሬታ ፈጥሯል። በተጨማሪም የመብት ተሟጋቾች መንግስት በተቃዋሚዎች፣ በጋዜጠኞች እና በሲቪል ማህበረሰብ አባላት ላይ የወሰደውን እርምጃ በጽኑ አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Tunisiyaatti namoonni hedduun pirezidanti Qays Sa'iid aangoo gadhiisanii fi sirni bulchiinsa nama tokkoo akka xumuramu gaafachuun hiriira mormii geggeessaa jiru. Hanqinni meeshaalee bu'uuraa, gatiin jireenyaa dabaluu fi tajaajiloonni idilee gufachuun isaa sababa rakkoo dinagdee biyyattii mudateen uummata aarsaa jira. Kana malees, qaamoleen mirga namoomaa fi gartuuleen siyaasaa mootummaan mormitoota, gaazexeessitoota fi dhaabbilee sivilii irratti tarkaanfii fudhatu balaaleffatanii jiru.

title: Taliban release two detained UN staff members in Afghanistan
english: The Taliban have released two United Nations employees who were held in custody in Herat, Afghanistan, for over a week. While the men are now free and in good condition, officials have not disclosed why they were originally arrested. The UN is continuing to communicate with Afghan authorities to ensure the safety and security of all their personnel working in the country.
amharic: የታሊባን ባለስልጣናት በአፍጋኒስታን ከተማ ሄራት ለአንድ ሳምንት በላይ ታስረው የነበሩ ሁለት የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ሰራተኞችን ለቀዋል። ሰራተኞቹ በሰላም ወደ ቤታቸው የተመለሱ ቢሆንም፣ ስለ እስራታቸው ትክክለኛ ምክንያት እስካሁን የተሰጠ ማብራሪያ የለም። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ለሚሰሩ ሰራተኞቹ ደህንነት እና መብት ሲባል ከታሊባን ባለስልጣናት ጋር ውይይት ማድረጉን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mootummaan Xaalibaan hojjettoota dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii lama kan magaalaa Herat keessatti torbee tokkoo oliif hidhaman gadhiiseera. Namoonni kunneen nagaadhaan gadi lakkifamaniiru; ta’us, sababa isaan hidhamaniif hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane. Dhaabbanni mootummoota gamtoomanii nageenya hojjettoota isaanii biyyattii keessa jiran kabachiisuuf aangoota Xaalibaan waliin marii isaa itti fufeera.

title: US deports nearly 2,300 Mexicans to Guatemala over Mexico’s objections
english: The U.S. government has deported approximately 2,300 Mexican citizens to Guatemala, a move that the Mexican government has officially opposed. President Trump's administration is increasingly using these third-country removals as part of a broader strategy to manage migration. While Guatemala allows these individuals to transit through their territory to return home quickly, critics argue the practice unfairly leaves migrants stranded far from their own country.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ወደ 2,300 የሚጠጉ የሜክሲኮ ዜጎችን ወደ ጉዋቲማላ በግዳጅ መመለሱ በሜክሲኮ መንግስት ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። የፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አስተዳደር የስደተኞችን ቁጥር ለመቆጣጠር በማሰብ እነዚህን ሰዎች ወደ ሶስተኛ ሀገራት የመላክ እርምጃ እየወሰደ ይገኛል። ጉዋቲማላ እነዚህ ግለሰቦች በአገራቸው በኩል አልፈው ወደ ሜክሲኮ እንዲመለሱ ብትፈቅድም፣ ተቺዎች ግን ይህ አሰራር ስደተኞችን ከቤታቸው ርቀው እንዲቸገሩ የሚያደርግ ኢሰብአዊ ተግባር ነው ብለው ይወቅሳሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa lammiilee Meksikoo 2,300 ta'an gara biyya Gwaatimaalaatti erguun isaa mootummaa Meksikoo biratti mormii guddaa kaaseera. Bulchiinsi Pirezidaant Traamp dhuftii godaantotaa to'achuuf jecha, namoota kana biyya sadaffaatti erguu irratti bal'inaan hirmaachaa jira. Gwaatimaalaan namoonni kun biyya isaanii keessa darbanii gara Meksikoo akka deebi'an hayyamtus, qaamoleen mirga namoomaaf falman garuu gochi kun godaantota biyya isaanii irraa fagoo bakka hin beekneetti dararuu dha jechuun mormaniiru.

title: Blast in Syria's Idlib kills at least three
english: A deadly explosion occurred in a residential home in the Syrian village of Ain al-Qasab, resulting in the deaths of three family members. Six other individuals, including the children of the deceased couple, were injured in the blast. Authorities believe the incident was caused by the improper storage of explosive materials intended for fishing.
amharic: በሶሪያ የአይን አል-ቃሳብ መንደር ውስጥ በሚገኝ መኖሪያ ቤት በደረሰ የፍንዳታ አደጋ ሦስት የቤተሰብ አባላት ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በዚሁ አደጋ የሟቾች ልጆችን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ስድስት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ባለሥልጣናት እንደገለጹት ፍንዳታው የደረሰው ለዓሣ ማጥመጃነት የሚያገለግሉ ፈንጂዎች በቤት ውስጥ ተከማችተው በመገኘታቸው ነው።
oromo: Ganda Ayni al-Qasab kan biyya Sooriyaa keessatti manni jireenyaa tokko dhuka'uun namoonni sadii du'aniiru. Namoonni ja'a kan biroon, ijoollee qindii sunis dabalatee, miidhamaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa akka jedhanitti, dhuka'ichi kan uumame meeshaaleen diinamitii qurxummii qabuuf oolan mana keessa kaa'amanii turan irraayi.

title: Four out of every five families in Gaza face 'critical or catastrophic' hunger levels, UN warns
english: A UN official reports that nearly the entire population of Gaza is currently struggling to find adequate housing and basic necessities. Over 80 percent of families are experiencing severe or extreme food insecurity while living in shelters that lack essential supplies like fuel and electricity. This humanitarian crisis has left millions in desperate need of urgent assistance.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንዳስታወቀው፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የጋዛ ህዝብ አብዛኛው ክፍል መኖሪያ ቤትና መሰረታዊ የኑሮ ፍላጎቶች እጥረት ገጥሞታል። ከ80 በመቶ በላይ የሚሆኑ ቤተሰቦች ነዳጅና ኤሌክትሪክ በሌለባቸው መጠለያዎች ውስጥ ከፍተኛ የረሃብ አደጋ ተጋርጦባቸዋል። ይህ አስከፊ ሁኔታ በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን በአስቸኳይ እርዳታ እንዲሹ አድርጓል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, yeroo ammaa jiraattonni Gaaza baay’een isaanii mana jireenyaa fi gargaarsa bu’uuraa dhabuun rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru. Maatiileen 80 irra hedduun isaanii, iddoo boba’aa fi humna ibsaa hin qabne keessa jiraachaa, beela cimaa fi ulfaataa keessa jiru. Rakkoon namoomee kun namoota miliyoonaan lakkaa’aman gargaarsa ariifachiisaa barbaachisu irra buusee jira.

title: Watch: Netanyahu warns Turkey over presence in Syria
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has warned that Israel will not accept a Turkish military expansion into southern Syria, viewing it as a direct security threat. This statement follows an Israeli airstrike on an airbase that they claimed was being improperly occupied by Turkish forces. However, the Syrian government has denied these claims, stating that the facility is only being repaired for the use of its own air force.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ቱርክ በሶሪያ ደቡባዊ ክፍል ወታደራዊ ይዞታዋን ማስፋፋቷ ለእስራኤል የደህንነት ስጋት ስለሆነ ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው አስታወቁ። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው እስራኤል በቱርክ ኃይሎች ተይዟል ብላ ባመነችው የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ከሰነዘረች በኋላ ነው። በሌላ በኩል የሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር የአየር ማረፊያው ለሶሪያ አየር ኃይል አገልግሎት እንዲውል እየተጠገነ እንጂ የቱርክ ወታደራዊ ይዞታ እንዳልሆነ በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብሏል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun, Turkey qilleensa irra qajeelchuun gara kibba Suuriyaatti babal'achuun ishee nageenya Israa'el waan sodaachisuuf fudhatama akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kenname, Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa Turkey to'atteetti jetti amantee irratti erga haleellaa raawwatte booda. Gama biraatiin, mootummaan Suuriyaas buufatichi kan suphaa jiru humna xiyyaaraa biyya isaaniitiif malee buufata waraana Turkey akka hin taane dubbachuun himata sana mormaniiru.

title: How much could Trump's 'economic D-Day' hurt Iran?
english: President Trump is planning a major new economic strategy against Iran, referred to as an 'economic D-Day,' which aims to severely punish any nation that continues trading with them. US officials argue that this increased financial pressure is the best way to reach their goals, even though Iran has historically adapted to sanctions. The specific details of these measures are expected to be announced by the US Treasury soon.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ሀገራት ላይ ከፍተኛ እርምጃ የሚወሰድበት አዲስ 'የኢኮኖሚ ዲ-ዴይ' የተሰኘ ዕቅድ አውጥተዋል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ይህ ግፊት ግባቸውን ለማሳካት ውጤታማ መንገድ ነው ብለው የሚያምኑ ቢሆንም፣ ኢራን በረዥም ጊዜ ማዕቀቦች ውስጥ ለመኖር የለመደች ሀገር ናት። የዚህ ማዕቀብ ዝርዝር መግለጫ በአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር በቅርቡ ይፋ እንደሚሆን ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp biyyoota Iraan waliin daldala itti fufan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf 'Ikoonomii Dii-Dee' kan jedhamu karoora haaraa qopheessaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa dhiibbaan diinagdee kun galma isaanii gahuuf furmaata gaarii akka ta'e dubbatanis, Iraan waggoota dheeraaf dhiibbaa diinagdee dandamattee turteetti. Ibsi bal'aan waa'ee tarkaanfiiwwan kanaa dhiheenyatti ministira faayinaansii Ameerikaatiin kan ifoomu ta'a.

title: Trump wants to be friends with Kim - but South Korea could pay the price
english: President Trump has abruptly ordered an end to joint military exercises with South Korea, labeling the drills too costly and provocative toward North Korea. This unilateral move, taken without prior consultation, has surprised South Korean officials and raised concerns about the strength of the U.S. alliance in the region. There is growing fear that the U.S. might further reduce its military presence or shift its policy toward North Korea, potentially leaving Seoul vulnerable.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር የሚያደርጉትን የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ፣ ውድ እና ለሰሜን ኮሪያ ቀስቃሽ ነው በሚል በድንገት አቁመዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ባለስልጣናት ጋር ሳይመካከር መወሰዱ፣ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የጸጥታ ግንኙነት አስተማማኝነት ጥያቄ ውስጥ አስገብቷል። በዚህም ምክንያት አሜሪካ በኮሪያ ባሕረ ገብ መሬት ላይ ያላትን የጦር ኃይል በመቀነስ ረገድ ለደቡብ ኮሪያ ያላትን የደህንነት ዋስትና እንዳትጥል ስጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Tiraamp, leenjiin waraanaa Koriyaa Kibbaa waliin godhamaa ture gatii guddaa kan gaafatuu fi Koriyaa Kaabaa kan aarsu ta'uu ibsuun tasa akka dhaabbatu ajajaniiru. Murtii kanaan dura marii malee fudhatame kana, aanga'oonni Koriyaa Kibbaa waan itti hin yaadamne ta'uu fi michummaa biyyoota lamaanii irratti shakki akka uumu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun, Ameerikaan waraana ishee naannicha keessaa yoo hiriste, nageenya Koriyaa Kibbaa irratti miidhaa geessisuu danda'a jedhanii yaadu.

title: Houthis and government trade attacks as Yemen slides back to full-scale war
english: Yemen is facing a resurgence of full-scale conflict as government forces launched over 80 attacks against Houthi positions, resulting in several casualties. Simultaneously, Houthi rebels conducted drone strikes on Saudi Arabian infrastructure, marking a significant escalation in tensions. This renewed fighting threatens the stability achieved by a UN-brokered truce established in 2022.
amharic: በየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ከ80 በላይ ጥቃቶችን በመሰንዘራቸው በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለው ግጭት ወደ ሙሉ ጦርነት እየተሸጋገረ ይገኛል። በበኩላቸው ሁቲዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ የድሮን ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ይህ አዲስ የቀውስ ሁኔታ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2022 በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት አማካኝነት የተደረሰውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ለአደጋ ዳርጓል።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraanni bal’inaan akka itti fufuuf waan sodaachisuuf, loltoonni mootummaa bakkeewwan Huutonni jiran irratti haleellaa gurguddaa 80 ol raawwataniiru. Gamasaaniin, gareen Huutotaa bu’uuraalee misoomaa Sa’udii Arabiyaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin qabneen deebii kennaniiru. Walitti bu’iinsi haaraan kun waliigaltee nagaa bara 2022 dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniin irra gahamee ture balaadhaaf saaxilaa jira.

title: US charges woman for allegedly plotting attack on New York State Capitol
english: US authorities have arrested 35-year-old Jessica Bowie for allegedly plotting a terrorist attack on the New York State Capitol. Prosecutors claim Bowie pledged allegiance to ISIL and intended to bomb the building to harm lawmakers before fleeing to Syria. The FBI successfully intervened after Bowie communicated with informants to acquire explosives and firearms for the planned assault.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት በኒውዮርክ ስቴት ካፒቶል ላይ የሽብር ጥቃት ለመፈጸም አቅዳ የነበረችውን የ35 ዓመቷን ጄሲካ ቦዊን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ተጠርጣሪዋ ለአይሲስ ታማኝነቷን በመግለጽ ሕግ አውጪዎችን ለመግደል እና ሕንጻውን ለማፈንዳት ማቀዷን አቃቤ ህጎች አስታውቀዋል። የኤፍቢአይ ምርመራ የቦምብ መስሪያ ቁሳቁሶችን እና መሳሪያዎችን ከሰዎች ጋር በመተባበር ለማግኘት ስትሞክር በቁጥጥር ስር ማዋል ችለዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Amerikaa dubartii umriin ishee 35 ta'e Jessica Bowi jedhamtu, gamoo Kapitolii New York irratti haleellaa shororkeessummaa raawwachuuf qophoofte jechuun hidheera. Himatamtuun kun garee ISIL-tiif amanamummaa ishee ibsuun, gamoo kana fashaleessuufi seera baastota ajjeesuuf karoora akka qabdu qorattoonni ibsaniiru. FBI qorannoo geggeesseen, dubartittiin meeshaalee baombii fi qawwee bitachuuf yeroo socho'aa turte to'annoo jala oolcheera.

title: The cost of rebuilding family homes in war-ravaged Syria
english: Following the downfall of the al-Assad regime, Syrian families are now facing the daunting challenge of reconstructing their lives and damaged homes. A recent report examines the immense personal and financial hurdles these residents must overcome to return to normalcy. As the country moves past the war, many are struggling to rebuild their communities from the ruins left behind.
amharic: የአል-አሳድ አገዛዝ ካበቃ በኋላ፣ የሶሪያ ቤተሰቦች ህይወታቸውን እና የወደሙ ቤቶቻቸውን መልሶ የመገንባት ከባድ ፈተና ገጥሟቸዋል። የቅርብ ጊዜ ዘገባ እንደሚያሳየው ነዋሪዎቹ ወደ መደበኛ ህይወት ለመመለስ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የገንዘብ እና የማህበራዊ ችግሮችን እያለፉ ነው። አገሪቱ ከጦርነቱ በኋላ አገግማለች ቢባልም፣ ብዙዎች ግን የወደሙ መንደሮቻቸውን መልሶ ለመገንባት ትልቅ ትግል ውስጥ ናቸው።
oromo: Mootummaan al-Asaad erga kufee booda, maatiiwwan Siriyaa jireenya isaanii fi manneen isaanii kan manca’an haaromsachuuf qormaata cimaa keessa jiru. Gabaasni haaraa tokko akka ibsutti, jiraattonni gara jireenya isaanii isa duraatti deebi’uuf dhiibbaa dinagdee fi hawaasummaa guddaa keessa dabruu qabu. Biyyi sun erga waraana booda tasgabbooftee jirtus, namoonni baay’een gandoota isaanii manca’an haaromsuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: New York mayor Mamdani sues to block $10,000 teaching aide bonuses
english: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has filed a lawsuit to block a new law that mandates $10,000 bonuses for teaching aides. The mayor argues that this legislation interferes with established collective bargaining agreements and violates state labor regulations. Supporters of the bill, including the teachers' union, maintain that the bonuses are legal and necessary to support some of the city's lowest-paid school employees.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ከንቲባ ዞራን ማምዳኒ ለመምህራን ረዳቶች የ10,000 ዶላር ጉርሻ የሚሰጠውን አዲስ ህግ ለመቃወም ክስ መስርተዋል። ከንቲባው ህጉ ከነባር የጋራ የድርድር ስምምነቶች እና ከክልሉ የሰራተኛ ህግ ጋር እንደሚጋጭ ይከራከራሉ። የህጉ ደጋፊዎች እና የመምህራን ማህበር በበኩላቸው፣ ክፍያው ህጋዊ መሆኑን እና በከተማው ውስጥ ዝቅተኛ ገቢ ያላቸውን ሰራተኞች ለመደገፍ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Niiw Yoorkitti kan argaman kantiibaan Zohran Maamdaanii, gargaartota barsiisotaaf badhaasa $10,000 kaffaluuf seerri ba'e akka dhaabbatuuf himannaa mana murtii bananiiru. Kantiibaan kun seerri kun walii galtee hojjettootaa fi seera hojii mootummaa wajjin wal faallessa jedhanii mormu. Gama biraatiin, deggertoonni seera kanaa fi gamtaan barsiisotaa, kaffaltiin kun seera qabeessa ta'uu fi hojjettoota mindaa xiqqaa argatan gargaaruuf barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli strikes target southern Lebanon and Syria
english: Israeli military forces have conducted fresh attacks against locations in both southern Lebanon and Syria. Strikes were reported in the Ali al-Taher region of Lebanon, while artillery fire was directed at farmland near the village of Jubata al-Khashab in the Golan Heights. These incidents represent the latest escalations in the ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ እና በሶሪያ በሚገኙ አካባቢዎች ላይ አዳዲስ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። ጥቃቶቹ በሊባኖስ አሊ አል-ታሂር አካባቢ የተፈጸሙ ሲሆን፣ በሶሪያ ጎላን ኮረብታ አካባቢም በግብርና መሬቶች ላይ የመድፍ ተኩስ ተከፍቷል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን ውጥረት የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'eel kibba Libaanoosifi biyya Sooriyaa keessatti bakkeewwan garagaraa irratti haleellaa haaraa gaggeessaniiru. Haleellaan kunneen naannoo Alii Al-Taahir kan Libaanoos keessatti kan raawwataman yoo ta'u, biyya Sooriyaa naannoo Golaan Hayts bakkeewwan qonnaa irratti ammoo gadihiinsa rasaasaa gurguddaa gaggeessaniiru. Gochileen kunneen waldhabdee naannichatti itti fufaa jiru kan agarsiisanidha.

title: Nearly everyone in Gaza in need of shelter aid, NRC says
english: A report from the Norwegian Refugee Council highlights that nearly 2 million people in Gaza, or 94 percent of the population, require urgent shelter and household support. Most residents are forced to live in inadequate tents or temporary structures surrounded by dangerous environmental hazards like sewage and rubble. With aid supplies nearly exhausted and very few families receiving assistance, experts are calling for urgent international intervention to provide necessary relief.
amharic: የኖርዌይ የስደተኞች ምክር ቤት ባወጣው አዲስ ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ በጋዛ የሚገኙ ወደ ሁለት ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ሰዎች አስቸኳይ የመጠለያ እና የቤት ቁሳቁስ ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልጋቸው ተገልጿል። አብዛኛው የጋዛ ነዋሪ በቆሻሻ፣ በፍርስራሽ እና በሌሎች አደገኛ ሁኔታዎች በተከበቡ ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ውስጥ ለመኖር ተገደዋል። የእርዳታ አቅርቦት እጅግ በጣም ውስን በመሆኑ፣ ዓለም አቀፍ ማህበረሰብ አስቸኳይ የመፍትሄ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Gabaasni 'Norwegian Refugee Council' jedhamu akka ibsetti, namoonni Gaaza keessa jiraatan miliyoona lama ta'an gargaarsa mana jireenyaa fi meeshaalee bu'uuraa hatattamaan akka barbaadan ibseera. Namoonni hedduun dunkaana ykn iddoo yerootti qophaa'e keessa jiraachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, bakkeewwan kunis xurii fi balaawwan garaagaraan kan marfamaniidha. Meeshaaleen gargaarsaa waan dhumanneef, dhaabbileen gargaarsaa addunyaa hatattamaan gargaarsa akka dhiyeessan gaafatamaniiru.

title: In photos: Funeral of 17-year-old Palestinian killed by Israel in March
english: A funeral was held on Thursday in the West Bank village of Sinjil for 17-year-old Salim Sami Salim Fuqaha. Israeli authorities had kept the teenager's body since he was killed in mid-March. His family and community finally gathered to lay him to rest after his remains were released.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ ሲንጂል መንደር ውስጥ በመጋቢት ወር በተገደለው የ17 ዓመቱ ሳሊም ሳሚ ሳሊም ፉቃሃ የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓት ሐሙስ ዕለት ተፈጽሟል። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት የወጣቱን አስከሬን ከተገደለበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ ለወራት ይዘውት ቆይተው ነበር። አስከሬኑ ከተለቀቀ በኋላ ቤተሰቦቹ እና የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች በመገኘት የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓቱን አከናውነዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa magaala Sinjil kan Qilleensa Dhihaatti, awwaalcha dargaggoo waggaa 17 Salim Saamii Salim Fuqahaa kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, inni immoo ji'a Bitootessaa keessa ajjeefame ture. Qaamoleen mootummaa Israa'el reeffa dargaggeessa kanaa erga inni ajjeefamee kaasee ji'ootaaf qabatanii turan. Reeffichi erga gadhiifamee booda, maatiin isaa fi hawaasni naannichaa walitti qabamuun sirna awwaalcha isaa raawwataniiru.

title: Pakistan’s ex-PM Imran Khan reportedly moved to hospital from jail
english: Following a directive from the Supreme Court, Pakistan’s former Prime Minister Imran Khan has been transferred from Adiala jail to a hospital in Islamabad. This move comes after months of requests from his family and political party due to growing concerns regarding his health. Khan is expected to remain under medical supervision for several weeks, where he will be evaluated by a team of doctors, including his own personal physician.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን፣ በጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ ከጃይል ወደ እስላማባድ ሆስፒታል ተዛውረዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የፖለቲካ ፓርቲያቸው እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው በጤና ሁኔታቸው ላይ ባነሱት ስጋት ምክንያት ለወራት ሲጠይቁት የቆየውን ጥያቄ ተከትሎ ነው። ካን ቢያንስ እስከሚቀጥለው የፍርድ ቤት ቀጠሮ ድረስ በህክምና ቡድን ቁጥጥር ስር ሆነው ህክምናቸውን እንደሚከታተሉ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Paakistaan duraanii Imraan Kaan, ajaja Mana Murtii Olaanaatiin mana hidhaa Adiyaalaa irraa gara hospitaala Islaamaabaaditti jijjiiramaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, maatii fi paartii isaanii fayyaa isaaniirratti yaaddoo qabaachuu isaaniitiin ji'ootaaf gaaffii dhiheessaa turan erga deebii argatee booda. Kaan hanga guyyaa beellama mana murtii itti aanutti garee ogeeyyee fayyaan qorannoo godhamuufii fi hospitaala keessatti akka turan eegama.

title: Dozens dead after boat capsizes in north-western Nigeria
english: A boat carrying over 70 people, primarily children heading to a rice farm, capsized in Nigeria's Sokoto state, resulting in at least 46 deaths. While 16 passengers were rescued, search operations continue for those still missing in the remote area. These tragedies are frequent in Nigeria due to overcrowded vessels, poor boat maintenance, and inadequate safety enforcement.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ ሶኮቶ ግዛት ከ70 በላይ ሰዎችን የጫነ ጀልባ በመስጠሙ ቢያንስ 46 ሰዎች መሞታቸው ተረጋግጧል። በጀልባዋ ላይ የነበሩት አብዛኞቹ ህጻናት ወደ ሩዝ እርሻ ስራ በመጓዝ ላይ የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን 16 ሰዎች ብቻ በህይወት መትረፋቸው ታውቋል። በናይጄሪያ የጀልባ አደጋዎች በተደጋጋሚ የሚከሰቱት የጀልባዎች ብልሽት፣ የሰዎች መብዛት እና የደህንነት ቁጥጥር ማነስ በመኖሩ ነው።
oromo: Naayijeeriyaa keessatti bidiruu namoota 70 ol baattee gara qonnaa garbuu deemaa turte tokko Sokoto keessatti gombifamteen lubbuun namoota 46 darbeera. Namoonni 16 fayyanii ooluu danda'aniiru garuu barbaacha namoota badee jiru itti fufee jira. Balaan kun kan mudate guutummaa fi suphama dhabuu bidiruuwwanii akkasumas seera eegumsaa laafaa ta'e irraa kan ka'e dha.

title: US pummels Cuban economy with new sanctions on mining, construction
english: The United States has imposed new economic sanctions on nine Cuban state-owned companies involved in the mining, metal, and construction industries. Additionally, three officials from the Cuban Institute of Friendship with the Peoples were penalized over allegations of subversive international activities. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated these measures are intended to pressure the Cuban government and prevent it from influencing American citizens. This move is part of an ongoing policy to weaken the current administration in Cuba through maximum economic pressure.
amharic: አሜሪካ በኩባ የማዕድን፣ የብረታ ብረት እና የግንባታ ዘርፎች ላይ የተሰማሩ ዘጠኝ የመንግስት ተቋማት ላይ አዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ጥላለች። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም፣ የኩባ ህዝቦች ወዳጅነት ተቋም ሶስት አመራሮች በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ አደገኛ ተግባራት ላይ ተሳትፈዋል በሚል ማዕቀብ ተጥሎባቸዋል። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ እርምጃው የኩባን መንግስት ለመጫን እና የአሜሪካ ዜጎች ላይ ተጽእኖ እንዳያሳድሩ ለማድረግ ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ የቅርብ ጊዜ ውሳኔ አሜሪካ በኩባ መንግስት ላይ እያደረሰች ያለችውን ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና አካል ነው።
oromo: Amerikaa qabeenya mootummaa Kuubaa kanneen akka albuuda baasuu, sibiila fi ijaarsa keessatti bobba’an sagal irratti kaffaltii diinagdee haaraa buufteetti. Kana malees, hoogganoonni dhaabbata michummaa ummata Kuubaa sadii hojii farra mootummaa irratti hirmaataniiru jedhamanii adabamanii jiru. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo tarkaanfiin kun mootummaa Kuubaa dhiibbaa keessa galchuu fi dhiibbaa lammiilee Ameerikaa irratti uumuu akka dhaabsisan ifoomsaniiru. Murteen kun dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa Ameerikaan mootummaa Kuubaa irratti gochaa jirtu keessaa kan madduudha.

title: Landslide at illegal gold mine kills 13 people in Colombia
english: A tragic landslide at an unauthorized gold mine in southwestern Colombia has claimed the lives of at least 13 individuals. The site was primarily operated by members of the local Quillacinga indigenous community, with around 50 people typically working there. Emergency responders are currently attending to seven other people who were injured in the collapse.
amharic: በደቡብ ምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በሚገኝ ሕገ-ወጥ የወርቅ ማውጫ ቦታ በተከሰተ የመሬት መንሸራተት ቢያንስ 13 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው የደረሰው በአብዛኛው የኩያሲንጋ ተወላጆች በሚሰሩበት ማዕድን ማውጫ ውስጥ ሲሆን፥ ሰባት ሰዎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በቦታው በአጠቃላይ 50 ያህል ሰዎች በስራ ላይ እንደነበሩ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa kibba-dhihaatti bakka warqee seeraan ala baasan tokkotti lafti sigigaatee lubbuun namoota 13 darbeera. Namoonni miidhangan kun kanneen gosa Kuyaasingaa jedhamanii fi hojii kana irratti bobba'anii turan yoo ta'u, namoonni biroo torba ammoo madaa'aniiru. Bakka sanatti namoonni 50 ta'an hojjechaa kan turan yoo ta'u, amma qorannoon fi gargaarsi namoota miidhamanii itti fufaa jira.

title: Hundreds of Tibetans protest China’s ethnic unity law by shaving heads
english: Hundreds of Tibetan exiles gathered in New Delhi to express their strong opposition to a new Chinese law focused on ethnic unity. As part of their peaceful demonstration, many of the protesters shaved their heads to symbolize their defiance against the policy. The participants criticized the legislation, arguing that it threatens their cultural identity and autonomy.
amharic: በኒው ዴልሂ የሚኖሩ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የቲቤት ስደተኞች በቻይና የብሔር አንድነት ህግ ላይ ያላቸውን ተቃውሞ ገለጹ። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በህጉ ላይ ያላቸውን ተቃውሞ ለማሳየት ራሳቸውን በመላጨት ድርጊታቸውን አሳይተዋል። እነዚህ ተሳታፊዎች ህጉ የቲቤታውያንን ባህል እና መብት የሚጋፋ ነው ሲሉ ተችተዋል።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Tibbet dhibbaan lakkaawaman Niiw Deelhiitti walga'uun seera tokkummaa sanyii Chaayinaan baaste mormaniiru. Namoonni hiriira ba'an kunneen mormii isaanii ibsachuuf rifeensa mataa isaanii kan haadan yoo ta'u, seerichi eenyummaa fi mirga aadaa ummata Tibbet miidha jechuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Heartbreak, loss on Lebanon’s front lines, the story of a first responder
english: The documentary 'The Ones We Couldn’t Save' profiles Ali Safiuddin, a dedicated Lebanese civil defense worker. Despite suffering personal tragedy, including the loss of his young daughter and several coworkers to conflict, he remains committed to his dangerous rescue work. His story highlights the profound bravery and emotional burden faced by first responders serving in southern Lebanon.
amharic: «የማንችላቸው» የተሰኘው ዘጋቢ ፊልም አሊ ሳፊዲን የተባሉትን የሊባኖስ ሲቪል መከላከያ ሰራተኛ ህይወት ይቃኛል። በግጭቶች ምክንያት ሴት ልጃቸውን እና የቅርብ የስራ ባልደረቦቻቸውን ያጡ ቢሆንም፣ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ የሚያደርጉትን ተጋድሎ አላቆሙም። ይህ ታሪክ በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚሰሩ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች የሚገጥማቸውን ከፍተኛ የህይወት መስዋዕትነት እና የውስጥ ስቃይ ያሳያል።
oromo: Fiilmiin 'The Ones We Couldn’t Save' jedhamu kan dubbatu Ali Safiuddin hojjetaa ittisa sivilii Liibaanoos ta'an irratti. Osoo ijoollee isaa fi hoggantoota isaa waraanaanis dhabee jiru, ammas lubbuu namoota biraa oolchuuf murannoo qaba. Seenaan kun gargaartoonni yeroo muddamaa bakka waraanaa Liibaanoos kibbaa keessatti injifannoo fi gadda guddaa keessa akka jiran mul'isa.

title: Four railway workers killed by express train at station in Japan
english: Four railway maintenance workers lost their lives after being struck by an express train while applying herbicide to tracks north of Tokyo. Although a designated lookout had indicated that the area was safe, the train collided with the crew regardless. Officials are currently conducting an investigation to determine the cause of this fatal error.
amharic: ጃፓን ውስጥ ቶኪዮ በስተሰሜን በሚገኝ የባቡር መስመር ላይ አረም ሲረጩ የነበሩ አራት የባቡር ሠራተኞች በፍጥነት በሚሄድ ባቡር ተገጭተው ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የሥራ ቦታው ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ መሆኑን በቦታው የነበረ ጠባቂ ምልክት ሰጥቶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ አደጋው ሊከሰት ችሏል። ባለሥልጣናት አደጋው እንዴት ሊደርስ እንደቻለ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Jaappaan keessatti, kaaba Toookiyoo iddoo jirutti namoonni afur qulqulleessa karaa baaburaa irratti hojjechaa turan baabura saffisaa kanaan dha'amanii lubbuun isaanii darbe. Hojjettoonni kunneen iddoo sana qulqulleessaa utuu jiranii, nama bakka sana eegu irraa karaichi qulqulluu ta'uu erga ibsamee booda balaan kun mudate. Aangoyyoonni dhimma kana irratti qorannoo eegalaniiru.

title: Israeli forces block Ramallah Governor’s departure, following slain teen’s funeral
english: Israeli soldiers briefly detained the governor of Ramallah, Laila Ghannam, after she attended the funeral of a Palestinian teenager in the town of Sinjil. Authorities had returned the body of 17-year-old Salim Fuqaha, who was killed by Israeli forces in March, on the same day. Soldiers stopped the governor's vehicle at the town's exit and confiscated her keys before eventually letting her leave.
amharic: የራማላህ ገዢ ላይላ ጋናም በሲንጂል ከተማ የተገደለ ወጣት የቀብር ሥነ ስርዓት ላይ ከተሳተፉ በኋላ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ታግደው ቆይተዋል። ባለስልጣናቱ ከመጋቢት ወር ጀምሮ ይዘውት የነበረውን የ17 ዓመቱ ሳሊም ፉቃሃ አስከሬን ለቤተሰቦቹ ከሰጡ በኋላ የቀብር ሥነ ስርዓቱ ተካሂዷል። ወታደሮቹ የገዢዋን መኪና መውጫ ላይ በማቆም ቁልፉን ቢወስዱም፣ በኋላ ላይ ግን እንዲያልፉ ፈቅደውላቸዋል።
oromo: Geggeessituun magaalaa Raamaallaah, Layilaa Ghaanaam, awwaalcha dargaggeessa tokkoo irratti erga hirmaattee booda waraana Israa'elidhaan daangeeffamtee turte. Aangoonni Israa'el reeffa dargaggeessa umuriin isaa 17 ta'e Saalim Fuqaah, ji'a Bitootessaa keessa waraanichaan ajjeefamee ture guyyaa sanatti maatii isaatiif kennaniiru. Waraanni sun konkolaataa geggeessituutti daandii irratti erga dhaabanii fi furjiidhaa isaanii erga fudhatanii booda, boodarra akka deemtu hayyamaniiru.

title: Could US sanctions destroy the International Criminal Court?
english: The United States has imposed new sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) following the tribunal's move to issue arrest warrants for Israeli officials over the conflict in Gaza. These actions have drawn sharp criticism from global entities like the United Nations and the European Union, despite support from Israel. The move raises significant concerns regarding the future stability and independence of the international legal body.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በጋዛ በሚፈጸመው ጦርነት ምክንያት የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናትን በቁጥጥር ስር ለማዋል አለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት (ICC) ባሳለፈው ውሳኔ በመበሳጨት በድርጅቱ ላይ አዲስ ማዕቀብ ጥሏል። ይህ የአሜሪካ እርምጃ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እና በአውሮፓ ህብረት ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ምንም እንኳን እስራኤል ውሳኔውን ብትደግፈውም፣ ይሄ ድርጊት የፍርድ ቤቱን ነፃነት እና የወደፊት ህልውና ላይ ጥያቄ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa Manni Maree yakka adunyaa (ICC) waraana Gaazaarratti hirmaachuu isaaniin walqabatee hoogganoota Israa'elirratti ajaja hidhaa baasuun isaa mufachiisee, tarkaanfii sanarratti qeeqaa fi daangaa haaraa kaa'eera. Tarkaanfiin kun dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi Gamtaa Awurooppaa biratti balaaleffannaa guddaa kan hordofsiise yoo ta'u, Israa'el garuu tarkaanfichaan gammaduu ishee ibsiteetti. Gochi kun gara fuulduraatti bu'uuraa fi bilisummaa manneen murtii idil-addunyaa kanatti rakkoo uumuu danda'a soda jedhu uumeera.

title: Walmart sees sales drop as US consumer spending retreats
english: Walmart experienced its slowest quarterly sales growth in six years as rising fuel costs and inflation caused shoppers to reduce their spending. The company's stock fell significantly after it missed performance forecasts and reported that consumers are prioritizing essential goods due to high prices. To address these challenges and compete in a difficult economic climate, the retailer is cutting prices on thousands of items.
amharic: የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት እና የኑሮ ውድነት ሸማቾች ወጪያቸውን እንዲቀንሱ በማድረጋቸው፣ ዋልማርት በስድስት ዓመታት ውስጥ ታይቶ በማያውቅ መልኩ ዝቅተኛ የሽያጭ እድገት አስመዝግቧል። ኩባንያው ከገበያ ባለሙያዎች ከተጠበቀው በታች ውጤት በማምጣቱ የአክሲዮን ዋጋው ቀንሷል። ተግዳሮቶቹን ለመቋቋም እና ተወዳዳሪ ለመሆን፣ ዋልማርት በሺዎች በሚቆጠሩ ምርቶች ላይ የዋጋ ቅናሽ እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Gatiin boba'aa dabaluu fi gatiin meeshaalee gabaa keessatti ol ka'uun isaa maamiltoonni akka qusannoo godhatan dirqisiiseera; kana irraa kan ka'e, Walmart waggaa ja'a keessatti guddina gurgurtaa isa gadaanaa galmeesseera. Bu'aan gurgurtaa kampanii kanaa kan eegamee gad ta'uu isaatiin qoodni (stock) isaa gadi bu'eera. Walmart jijjiirama dinagdee kana dandamachuu fi maamiltoota isaa deebisanii harkisuuf, gatii meeshaalee kuma kudha tokkoo ol ta'an irratti hir'ina godheera.

title: Opinion: Amid genocide in Gaza, why must Palestinian journalists uphold the illusion of neutrality?
english: The Israeli military recently killed Al Jazeera cameraman Ahmed Wishah in a drone strike, shortly after his brother, Mohammed Wishah, was killed in a similar attack. Research from Brown University indicates that the conflict in Gaza has resulted in the deaths of more journalists than many major 20th-century wars combined. These tragic events have sparked criticism regarding the demand for journalistic neutrality while reporters face direct targeting in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች የአልጀዚራ ካሜራ ባለሙያ የሆኑትን አህመድ ዊሻን በድሮን ጥቃት ገድለዋል። ከጥቂት ወራት በፊት ወንድማቸው መሐመድ ዊሻም በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ መገደሉ ይታወሳል። የብራውን ዩኒቨርሲቲ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በጋዛ ያለው ጦርነት ከብዙ ታላላቅ የ20ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ጦርነቶች በበለጠ ቁጥር ጋዜጠኞችን ለሞት ዳርጓል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ጋዜጠኞች በግልጽ እየታለሙ በሚገኙበት አካባቢ የገለልተኛነት ግዴታን መጠበቅ ምን ያህል አስቸጋሪ እንደሆነ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el gabaasaa fi kaameraa manaa Al Jazeera kan ta'an Ahmed Wishah haleellaa xiyyaara maleeyyuun ajjeeseera, kunis obboleessi isaanii Mohammed Wishah erga haleellaa walfakkaatuun ajjeefamee ji'oota muraasa booda kan dhufe dha. Qorannoon Yuunivarsiitii Brown akka agarsiisutti, waraanni Gaaza keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru lakkoofsa gaazexessitoota waraana jaarraa 20ffaa keessatti du'an caalaa ajjeeseera. Taateewwan gaddisiisoon kun gaazexessitoonni bakka waraanaatti osoo qabatamanii ajjeefamanii, dirqamni 'giddugaleessummaa' ykn 'neetiraalii' ta'uu ammas akka itti fufu gaafachuun sirrii ta'uu isaa irratti mormii kaaseera.

title: Israeli opinion article says Turkey's Nato protection does not apply to troops in Syria
english: A recent opinion piece in the Israeli newspaper Israel Hayom argues that Turkey's NATO membership does not protect its military forces operating in Syria. The author asserts that Israel remains free to target these troops because collective defense agreements do not extend beyond a member nation’s own borders. This analysis follows recent Israeli airstrikes on Syrian sites allegedly slated for Turkish military use, highlighting rising regional tensions despite Turkey’s warming ties with the United States.
amharic: በእስራኤል ሀዮም ጋዜጣ ላይ የወጣ አንድ የሃሳብ መጣጥፍ የቱርክ የኔቶ አባልነት በሶሪያ ለሚገኙ የቱርክ ወታደሮች ጥበቃ እንደማይሰጥ ገልጿል። የኔቶ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት የሀገሪቱን ድንበር የሚያልፉ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎችን እንደማይሸፍን በመጥቀስ እስራኤል በሶሪያ የሚገኙ የቱርክ ኃይሎችን ለማጥቃት ሙሉ መብት እንዳላት መጣጥፉ ይከራከራል። ይህ ትንታኔ የመጣው እስራኤል በቱርክ ወታደሮች ጥቅም ላይ ሊውሉ የታቀዱ የሶሪያ ጣቢያዎች ላይ የአየር ድብደባ ካደረሰች በኋላ ሲሆን፣ በቱርክ እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት እያደገ ቢመጣም በክልሉ ያለው ውጥረት አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Barruun yaadaa tokko gaazexaa Israa'el Hayom irratti bahe, miseensummaan Neetoo (NATO) kan biyya Turkii waraana isaanii kan Siiriyaa keessa jiran kan ittisu miti jedha. Walii galteen ittisa gamtaa kan Neetoo daangaa biyyattii ala kan hin hojjenne ta'uu ibsuun, Israa'el loltoota Turkii kanneen Siiriyaa keessa jiran haleeluuf mirga guutuu qabdi jechuun mormu. Yaadni kun kan dhufe, Israa'el buufataalee waraanaa kan Turkii itti fayyadamuuf karoorfatte haleeluushee booda yoo ta'u, kunis hariiroon Turkii fi Ameerikaa jidduu jiru fooyya'aa jiraatus, walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa garmalee cimaa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: US Treasury chief urges China to back proposed Iran sanctions
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has called on China to support new sanctions against Iran. He argued that Beijing would gain economic advantages if the Strait of Hormuz remained open and global energy costs decreased. Although he did not confirm potential penalties for Chinese firms, he emphasized that it is in China's best interest to cooperate due to its heavy reliance on Gulf energy supplies.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት በኢራን ላይ የታቀዱ ማዕቀቦችን ቻይና እንድትደግፍ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ክፍት ሆኖ የኢነርጂ ዋጋ ቢቀንስ ለቤጂንግ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጠቀሜታ እንደሚኖረው አስረድተዋል። ምንም እንኳን በቻይና ኩባንያዎች ላይ ሊወሰዱ ስለሚችሉ እርምጃዎች በግልፅ ባይናገሩም፣ ቻይና በባህረ ሰላጤው ሀገራት የኢነርጂ አቅርቦት ላይ ያላትን ጥገኝነት ከግምት በማስገባት ከዋሽንግተን ጋር አብራ መስራት እንደሚጠቅማት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa US Iskoot Besent, Chaayinaan sagantaa sanadoota adabaa Iran irratti yaadamu deeggaruu akka qabdu gaafataniiru. Innis, yoo daandiin Hormuz banamee fi gatiin anniisaa gadi bu'e, Chaayinaan faayidaa dinagdee akka argattu ibsaniiru. Dhaabbilee Chaayinaa irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatamuu danda'u irratti ifatti dubbachuu baatanis, Chaayinaan anniisaa naannoo Gulf irraa argattu irratti waan hirkattuuf, mootummaa US waliin hojjachuun ishee faayidaa akka qabu hubachiisaniiru.
