title: University suspends US academic leading Jason Arday plagiarism accusations
english: Ghent University has suspended researcher Nathan Cofnas, who spearheaded plagiarism allegations against the late Cambridge professor Jason Arday. The university stated the suspension is a disciplinary measure linked to upholding human dignity and opposing discrimination. Arday, who faced intense scrutiny and passed away recently at age 41, had resigned from his position citing the unbearable pressure caused by these accusations.
amharic: የጌንት ዩኒቨርሲቲ የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሮፌሰር የነበሩትን ጄሰን አርዳይን በምርምር ስርቆት ወንጀል ሲከሱ የነበሩትን ተመራማሪ ናታን ኮፍናስን አግዷል። ዩኒቨርሲቲው ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደው የሰውን ክብር ለመጠበቅ እና አድልዎን ለመቃወም በሚል ነው። በከፍተኛ የውጭ ጫና ውስጥ የነበሩትና በ41 ዓመታቸው በቅርቡ ህይወታቸው ያለፈው ፕሮፌሰር አርዳይ፣ በእነዚህ ክሶች ምክንያት የደረሰባቸውን ተጽዕኖ መቋቋም በማይችሉበት ደረጃ በመድረሱ ከስራ መልቀቃቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Yuunivarsiitiin Ghent qorataa Nathan Cofnas jedhamu, kan piroofeesara Yuunivarsiitii Cambridge kan turan Jason Arday irratti himata hatuu qorannoo dhiyeessaa turan, hojii irraa isa dhaabeera. Yuunivarsiitiin kun tarkaanfii kana kan fudhate kabaja namummaa eeguufi loogii mormuuf jechuudha. Dhiibbaa cimaa keessa kan turaniifi guyyoota muraasa dura umurii waggaa 41tti kan du'an piroofeesar Arday, himatoota kanneen irraa kan ka'e rakkoo irra ga'aa ture baachuu waan dadhabaniif hojii gadhiisuun isaanii ni yaadatama.

title: Arsenal vs Coventry: Premier League – prediction, lineups, teams
english: Defending Premier League champions Arsenal are set to open the new season against newly promoted Coventry City at the Emirates Stadium this Friday. While Arsenal aims to build on their title-winning campaign with new signing Bruno Guimaraes, they face uncertainty regarding the fitness of key players Declan Rice and Bukayo Saka. Coventry enters the top flight after a dominant Championship season and will look to challenge the reigning champions in their first match of the year.
amharic: የፕሪሚየር ሊጉ ባለድል አርሰናል አዲሱን የውድድር ዘመን የሊጉ መክፈቻ ጨዋታ ከኮቨንትሪ ሲቲ ጋር በኤምሬትስ ስታዲየም አርብ ዕለት ያደርጋል። አርሰናል አዲሱን ፈራሚ ብሩኖ ጊማሬሽን አካቶ የዋንጫ ተከላካይነቱን ለማስቀጠል ሲዘጋጅ፣ በዴክላን ራይስ እና በቡካዮ ሳካ የጤንነት ሁኔታ ላይ ጥርጣሬዎች ተፈጥረዋል። ኮቨንትሪ ሲቲ በበኩሉ ከቻምፒዮንሺፑ አሸናፊነት በኋላ ወደ ከፍተኛው የሊግ እርከን በመመለስ ጠንካራ ተፎካካሪ ለመሆን ይሞክራል።
oromo: Ajajoonni liigii Ingiliz kan ta'an Arsenal, torban kana guyyaa Jimaata tapha jalqabaa liigichaa taphattoota haaraa gara liigii gadii irraa dhufan Coventry City waliin dirree Emirates irratti ni taphatu. Arsenal taphataa haaraa Bruno Guimaraes dabalatee kabaja qabanii itti fufuuf kan karooratan yoo ta'u, garuu taphattoonni ijoon akka Declan Rice fi Bukayo Saka irratti madoon mudachuu mala. Coventry City gama isaanin, erga liigii Championship injifatanii booda, injifannoo liigii gubbaa kana irratti agarsiisuuf qophiidha.

title: US Treasury secretary says new economic measures will ‘collapse’ Iran
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has announced a plan to implement the most severe sanctions in history to economically isolate and collapse the Iranian government. The strategy involves a strict blockade and a ultimatum to the international community, warning that any nation continuing to trade with Iran will face significant US penalties. This move follows President Trump’s recent promise to launch an unprecedented economic campaign against Tehran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት የኢራንን መንግስት ለማዳከም እና ለማፍረስ ታሪክ የማይረሳው እጅግ ጠንካራ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ሀገራት በሙሉ ከባድ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድባቸው አስጠንቅቃለች። ይህ የኢኮኖሚ ዘመቻ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ኢራንን ሙሉ ለሙሉ ለማግለል የጀመረው ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Mallaqaa Ameerikaa Iskoot Beseenti, mootummaa Iraan diiguufi guddina ishee dhaabuuf adabbii diinagdee seenaa keessatti mul'ate hin beekne akka irra kaa'an beeksisaniiru. Ameerikaan biyyoonni Iraan waliin daldala itti fufan hundi adabbii cimaa akka isaan quunnamu akeekkachiisteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun qondaalonni Ameerikaa Iraan addunyaarraa adda baasuufi diinagdee ishee mancaasuuf karoorfatan keessatti kan galuudha.

title: Fishermen rescued after five days clinging to cooler at sea
english: Two fishermen were rescued by the Mexican Navy after surviving five days at sea. Their boat sank, forcing them to hold onto a cooler to stay afloat in the Pacific Ocean. They were discovered 240 kilometers from the coast and were airlifted to receive medical attention.
amharic: ሁለት ዓሣ አጥማጆች ጀልባቸዉ በመስጠሟ ምክንያት ለአምስት ቀናት በውቅያኖስ ላይ ተንሳፈው ከቆዩ በኋላ በሜክሲኮ የባህር ኃይል ታድገዋል። ዓሣ አጥማጆቹ በፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ ውስጥ በአሳ መያዣ ማቀዝቀዣ ላይ ተጣብቀው ተገኝተዋል። የባህር ኃይሉ ሰዎቹን ከባህር ዳርቻ በ240 ኪሎ ሜትር ርቀት ላይ ካገኛቸው በኋላ በአየር በኩል ለህክምና ልኳቸዋል።
oromo: Qacalee lachuu erga bidiruu isaanii bishaan keessatti dhidhimtee booda guyyaa shan guutuu galaana irratti hafan booda humna galaana Meeksiikootiin oolfamaniiru. Namoonni kun galaana Paasifiik keessatti meeshaa qabannaa qurxummii (cooler) qabatanii lubbuun hafan. Humnoonni kun qarqara galaanarraa kiilomeetira 240 fagaatanii argamanii, erga oolfamaniin booda xiyyaaraan gara hospitaalaatti geeffamaniiru.

title: Jewish-American barred by Israel calls settler violence ‘state terror’
english: Israeli authorities have blocked American activist Sam Sherman from returning to the country, likely due to his advocacy work for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. Sherman, who describes the actions of settlers as a form of state-sponsored terrorism, insists that this travel ban will not deter his ongoing human rights efforts. The Israeli government has not offered a formal reason for denying his re-entry.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት አሜሪካዊው አክቲቪስት ሳም ሸርማን ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዳይመለስ ከልክለዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ ለሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ድጋፍ በማድረጉ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ሸርማን በሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች የሚፈጸመውን ጥቃት የመንግስት ሽብርተኝነት ሲል የገለጸው ሲሆን፣ ይህ እገዳ የእሱን አክቲቪዝም እንደማያቆመው አስታውቋል። እስራኤል ለውሳኔዋ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ማብራሪያ አልሰጠችም።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el qabsoo mirga namoomaa kan geggeessu lammii Ameerikaa Saam Sharman gara biyyattii akka hin deebine dhorkiteetti. Kun kan ta'e, Sharman qe'ee qabamee jiru westa baankii keessatti namoota qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqifaman gargaaruu isaa hordofee dha. Sharman gochaa qe'ee qabatanii jiraattootaa 'shororkeessummaa mootummaan deeggaramu' jechuun kan ibse yoo ta'u, dhoorkaan kun qabsoo isaa akka hin dhaabne dubbateera. Israa'el sababa dhoorkaa kanaa ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti ifatti waan ibsite hin qabdu.

title: US visa sanctions expose the limits of diplomatic pragmatism
english: The U.S. government is facing criticism for imposing visa sanctions on Tigrayan leaders, a move viewed by critics as prioritizing political convenience over addressing genocide. These sanctions target officials who challenge the current peace implementation, effectively ignoring the need for accountability and justice for mass atrocities. By sidelining those who suffered in the conflict, the policy is accused of undermining the chances for a genuine and lasting peace in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በትግራይ መሪዎች ላይ የቪዛ ማዕቀብ መጣሉ፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን እና የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀልን ከመፍታት ይልቅ ፖለቲካዊ ጥቅምን ያስቀደመ ነው በሚል ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። ማዕቀቡ አሁን እየተተገበረ ባለው የሰላም ሂደት ላይ ጥያቄ የሚያነሱ አመራሮችን ያነጣጠረ በመሆኑ፣ ለደረሰው ግፍ ተጠያቂነትን የማስፈን አስፈላጊነትን ችላ ብሏል። ይህ አካሄድ ለተጎጂዎች ፍትህን ከመስጠት ይልቅ ለቀጣይ ዘላቂ ሰላም እንቅፋት እንደሚሆን ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hogganoota Tigraay irratti uggura viizaa kaa'uun isaa, yakka sanyi-fixaatii fi dararama raawwatame furuura irra fayyadamummaa siyaasaa dursuu akka ta'e komatamaa jira. Uggurri kun qaamolee adeemsa nagaa amma jiru irratti mormii qaban irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, kunis yakka raawwatameef itti gaafatamummaa mirkaneessuu dhiisuu akka ta'e himama. Adeemsi kun miidhamtootaaf haqaa kennuu mannaa, nagaa waaraa ta'e uumuuf gufuu ta'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: UK, France, Germany, Italy and Canada condemn Israel's West Bank settlement project
english: Major Western nations, including the UK, France, Germany, Italy, and Canada, have issued a joint statement demanding that Israel cancel plans to build over 1,200 new settlement homes in the occupied West Bank. Critics warn that this construction in the sensitive E1 area will fragment Palestinian territory, threatening the possibility of a two-state solution. International leaders expressed deep concern, noting that the project exacerbates current regional instability and contradicts international law.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ፣ የፈረንሳይ፣ የጀርመን፣ የጣሊያን እና የካናዳ መንግስታት በእስራኤል የተያዘው ምዕራባዊ የባንክ አካባቢ ላይ ከ1,200 በላይ አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን ለመገንባት የተያዘውን ዕቅድ በአንድነት አውግዘዋል። እነዚህ ሀገራት ዕቅዱ የፍልስጤምን ግዛት በመከፋፈል ለሁለት ሀገራት መፍትሄ ትልቅ እንቅፋት እንደሚሆን ገልጸው እስራኤል ውሳኔዋን እንድትቀለብስ ጠይቀዋል። ዓለም አቀፍ መሪዎች ይህ ፕሮጀክት በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት እንደሚያባብሰው እና ከዓለም አቀፍ ህግ ጋር እንደሚቃረን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni gurguddoon dhihaa kanneen akka UK, Faransaay, Jarmanii, Xaaliyaanii fi Kaanaadaa, Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa-gama Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti manneen jireenyaa haaraa 1,200 ol ijaaruuf karoorfatte akka dhaabdu gaafataniiru. Karoorri kun lafa Falasxiin gargar kutuudhaan furmaata biyyoota lamaa (two-state solution) rakkoo keessa akka galchuufi nageenya naannichaa akka booressu hoggantoonni kunneen ibsaniiru. Gochi kun seera idil-addunyaatiin kan hin hayyamamneefi rakkoo jiru kan hammeessu ta'uu isaatiif, biyyoonni kunneen Israa'el murtii kana akka irra deebitu cimsanii hubachiisaniiru.

title: Thai schools hold shooter drills after deadly attack
english: Schools throughout Thailand are conducting emergency training exercises to prepare for potential active shooter situations. These drills were initiated following a tragic incident where a teenager killed several people, including his grandparents, at a school near Bangkok. The goal of these sessions is to increase safety awareness and ensure students and staff know how to protect themselves during a crisis.
amharic: በታይላንድ የሚገኙ ትምህርት ቤቶች ሊያጋጥም የሚችል ተኩስን ለመከላከልና ዝግጁ ለመሆን የሚያስችሉ የአደጋ ጊዜ ልምምዶችን እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በአካባቢው በሚገኝ ትምህርት ቤት አንድ ታዳጊ ወጣት አያቶቹን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሰዎችን የገደለበትን አሳዛኝ ክስተት ተከትሎ ነው። የልምምዶቹ ዋና ዓላማ ተማሪዎችና መምህራን በአደጋ ጊዜ ህይወታቸውን እንዴት መጠበቅ እንዳለባቸው ማስተማር ነው።
oromo: Mana barnoota Taayilaand keessatti, haleellaa hidhattootaa ykn rasaasaan walqabate namoonni miidhamuu akka hin dandeenyeef qophiin ykn leenjiin yeroo ariifachiisaa godhamaa jira. Qophiin kun kan jalqabame, dargaggeessi tokko mana barnoota Baangkoook biratti argamu tokkotti namoota hedduu ajjeese erga raawwatamee booda. Leenjiin kun barattootaa fi barsiisonni yeroo balaan akkasii uumamu of eeggannoo akkamii gochuu akka qaban hubannoo kennuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: Ahmad Hassoun, Assad’s ‘barrel bomb mufti’, faces Damascus court verdict
english: Ahmad Hassoun, the former Grand Mufti of Syria who was a close ally of Bashar al-Assad, is awaiting a court verdict in Damascus this Monday. Prosecutors are seeking the death penalty for the religious leader, who was arrested in 2025 after the fall of the Assad regime. Hassoun gained notoriety for his vocal support of the government's violent crackdowns against protesters during the Syrian uprising.
amharic: የቀድሞው የሶሪያ ግራንድ ሙፍቲ አህመድ ሀሱን፣ የቀድሞው የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት ባሻር አል-አሳድ የቅርብ ወዳጅ የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ ሰኞ ዕለት በደማስቆ ፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ይጠባበቃሉ። አቃቤ ህግ ለሃይማኖታዊ መሪው የሞት ቅጣት እንዲወሰንባቸው ጠይቀዋል። እ.ኤ.አ በ2025 በአሳድ አገዛዝ ውድቀት ወቅት በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉት ሀሱን፣ በአመጽ ወቅት በመንግስት ለሚወሰዱ ጭካኔ የተሞላባቸው እርምጃዎች የነበራቸው ድጋፍ በሰፊው ሲተች ቆይቷል።
oromo: Ahmad Hassuun, kan kanaan dura Muftii Guddaa Siiriyaa fi michuu cimaa Baashaar al-Asaad turan, Dilbata dhufu kana murtee mana murtii Damasqoo eeggachaa jiru. Abbaan alangaa hogganaa amantii kana irratti adabbii du'aa akka murteessu gaafachaa jira. Namichi kun erga mootummaan Asaad kufee booda bara 2025 kan qabame yoo ta'u, yeroo mormiin Siiriyaa turetti tarkaanfii waraana mootummaan fudhatu deggeruun isaa beekama.

title: Bessent urges US partners to back plans to 'squash' Iran economy
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has called on international allies to join Washington in isolating Iran's economy through strict new sanctions. The administration aims to pressure the Iranian government into submission to avoid military conflict, warning that any nation continuing to trade with Tehran will face severe economic penalties. Further specifics regarding these measures are scheduled to be released during a press conference on August 24.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት አጋር ሀገራት በኢራን ኢኮኖሚ ላይ በምናደርገው ከፍተኛ ጫና እንዲተባበሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። አሜሪካ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደችው ወታደራዊ ግጭትን ለመከላከል እና የኢራንን መንግስት ለማዳከም ሲሆን፣ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነትን የሚቀጥሉ ሀገራት ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል። ስለ እቅዱ ዝርዝር መረጃ ነሐሴ 24 ቀን በሚሰጥ ጋዜጣዊ መግለጫ ይፋ እንደሚደረግም ታውቋል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Ameerikaa Iskootti Besent, biyyoonni michuu ta'an diinagdee Iraan miidhuuf akka isaan gargaaran waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte waraana hir'isuufi mootummaa Iraan irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf yoo ta'u, biyyi Iraan wajjin daldaluu itti fufu kamiyyuu adabbii cimaan akka isa qunnamu akeekkachiisaniiru. Ibsi bal'aan waa'ee karoorichaa guyyaa Hagayya 24 ibsa gaazexeessitootaaf kennamuun kan beekamu ta'a.

title: FBI raids ex-US Representative Swalwell’s home amid sexual misconduct probe
english: Federal agents have searched the home of former U.S. Representative Eric Swalwell as part of an ongoing sexual misconduct investigation. The FBI also confiscated his electronic devices at an airport following public allegations of assault and misconduct brought by several women. Swalwell, who previously resigned from Congress and exited the California governor's race, claims these actions are politically motivated due to his history of criticizing the current administration.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ምርመራ ቢሮ (FBI) የቀድሞው የምክር ቤት አባል ኤሪክ ስዋልዌል በጾታዊ ጥቃት እና በሌሎች እክሎች ላይ የተነሱ ክሶችን ለመመርመር በመኖሪያ ቤታቸው ፍተሻ አድርጓል። ባለስልጣናቱ እንዲሁም በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በቁጥጥር ስር ባዋሉት የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መሳሪያዎች ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው። ስዋልዌል ከዚህ ቀደም ከስልጣናቸው የለቀቁ ሲሆን፣ አሁን እየተደረገ ያለው ምርመራ መንግስትን በመተቸታቸው የሚወሰድባቸው የፖለቲካ በቀል እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Humni qorannoo federaalaa (FBI) mana jireenyaa miseensa korngeessii duraanii Erik Swalweel irratti, himannaa gocha saal-qunnamtii waliin walqabatu qulqulleessuuf sakatta'iinsa taasiseera. FBI'n akkasumas meeshaalee elektirooniksii isaanii buufata xiyyaaraa irratti kan qabatan yoo ta'u, kunis himannaa dubartoota hedduun irratti dhiyaateen walqabata. Swalweel duraan korngeessii fi duula filannoo geggeessaa mootummaa Kaalifoorniyaa gadhiisuun kan yaadatamu yoo ta'u, tarkaanfiin kun qeeqaa mootummaa waan ta'eef kan isaan irratti fudhatame jechuun himata.

title: Dozens dead after boat capsizes in northwestern Nigeria
english: A tragic boat accident in northwestern Nigeria has resulted in dozens of deaths after the vessel capsized while transporting farm workers. Local community members have already recovered at least 50 bodies, though authorities are still conducting rescue operations and have not yet confirmed an official final death toll. These types of accidents occur frequently in the region due to poor maintenance and the common practice of overloading boats.
amharic: በሰሜን ምዕራብ ናይጄሪያ ገበሬዎችን አሳፍሮ ሲጓዝ የነበረ ጀልባ በመስጠሙ በርካታ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እስካሁን ድረስ 50 የሚደርሱ አስከሬኖችን ያገኘ ሲሆን፣ የነፍስ አድን ስራው አሁንም ቀጥሏል። እንደዚህ አይነት አሳዛኝ አደጋዎች በአካባቢው በጀልባዎች መጫን እና የጥገና ጉድለት ምክንያት በተደጋጋሚ ይከሰታሉ።
oromo: Kaaba-lixaa Naayijeeriyaatti dooniin qonnaan bultoota fe'ee deemaa ture garagaltee lubbuun namoota hedduu darbeera. Hawaasni naannichaa hanga ammaatti reeffa namoota 50 ol ta'uu argachuu kan himan yoo ta'u, hojiin furmaataas itti fufee jira. Balaawwan gosa kanaa naannichatti kan uumaman dooniiwwan namoota hedduu fe'uu fi kunuunsi gaariin waan hin taasifamneefidha.

title: First group of US deportees, out of an expected 1,200, arrive in Liberia
english: The United States has begun transferring non-citizens to Liberia as part of a new policy under President Donald Trump to relocate deportees to third countries. The first group, consisting of 20 individuals mainly from Latin America, arrived in Monrovia this week, with plans to bring up to 1,200 people over the next year. While the U.S. has signed similar deals with many nations, Liberian officials have denied that their participation in this program is motivated by financial compensation.
amharic: አሜሪካ በፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር አዲስ ፖሊሲ መሰረት ስደተኞችን ወደ ሶስተኛ ሀገራት የመላክ ስራ ጀምራለች። በዚህም መሰረት ከላቲን አሜሪካ የመጡ 20 ግለሰቦችን የያዘ የመጀመሪያው ቡድን ወደ ላይቤሪያ ዋና ከተማ ሞንሮቪያ የገባ ሲሆን፣ በሚቀጥለው አንድ አመት ውስጥ እስከ 1,200 ሰዎችን የመቀበል እቅድ ተይዟል። አሜሪካ ከብዙ ሀገራት ጋር ተመሳሳይ ስምምነቶችን ብትፈራረምም፣ የላይቤሪያ መንግስት በፕሮግራሙ ውስጥ መሳተፉ ከገንዘብ ድጋፍ ጋር ምንም አይነት ግንኙነት እንደሌለው አስታውቋል።
oromo: Amerikaa sirna bulchiinsa Pireezidaant Donald Traamp jalatti godaantota biyya isaanii hin taane gara biyya sadaffaatti erguu jalqabdeetti. Gareen jalqabaa namoota 20 irraa ijaaramee fi baay'inaan biyyoota Laatiin Ameerikaa irraa dhufan, magaala guddoo Laayibeeriyaa Monroviyaa kan ga'an yoo ta'u, waggaa dhufu keessatti namoota 1,200 hanga ga'an simachuuf karoorfameera. Amerikaan biyyoota hedduu wajjin waliigaltee walfakkaatu mallatteessiteerti, garuu mootummaan Laayibeeriyaa hirmaannaan isaanii kun qarshii wajjin walitti dhufeenya akka hin qabne ibseera.

title: The road to el-Obeid, Sudan’s besieged city sheltering thousands
english: The Sudanese city of el-Obeid is currently under siege, providing shelter to hundreds of thousands of civilians amidst the ongoing conflict. The Rapid Support Forces are actively blocking humanitarian aid from reaching the desperate population trapped within the city. Reporting from the ground highlights the perilous conditions along key supply routes as the humanitarian crisis intensifies.
amharic: የሱዳኗ ኤል-ኦቤይድ ከተማ በአሁኑ ወቅት በበባህርይ እያለች ሲሆን፣ በግጭቱ ምክንያት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ተጠልለው ይገኛሉ። ፈጣን ድጋፍ ሰጪ ኃይሎች (RSF) ወደ ከተማዋ የሚገቡ የሰብአዊ እርዳታዎችን በንቃት እያገዱ ይገኛሉ። በቦታው ላይ የሚደረጉ ዘገባዎች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የሰብአዊ ቀውሱ እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ዋና ዋና የመዳረሻ መንገዶች ለከፍተኛ አደጋ የተጋለጡ ናቸው።
oromo: Magaalaan Sudaan, El-Obeid, amma jirtu kanaan marsamtee argamti; namootni dhibbaan lakkaa'amanis waraana sana jalaa baqachuun achi keessa jiraatu. Humnootni deeggarsa ariifachiisaa (Rapid Support Forces) gargaarsi namoomaa gara magaalattii akka hin geenye ittisaa jiru. Gabaasni iddoo sanarraa argame akka agarsiisutti, haalli jireenyaa fi geejjibaa daran hammaachaa jiraachuun rakkoo namoomaa daran cimaa deemaa jira.

title: Russian paramilitaries in Mali kill nine, including children: HRW
english: Human Rights Watch has accused Russian paramilitaries, known as the Africa Corps, of executing nine civilians, including four children, in the Malian village of Bombori. The report alleges that these killings occurred while Malian soldiers were present and involved detaining, beating, and burning the homes of local residents. The rights group is urging the Malian government to conduct an impartial investigation and hold those responsible for these atrocities accountable.
amharic: ሂዩማን ራይትስ ዋች 'አፍሪካ ኮርፕስ' የተባሉ የሩሲያ ታጣቂዎች በማሊ ቦምቦሪ መንደር ውስጥ አራት ሕፃናትን ጨምሮ ዘጠኝ ንፁሃን ዜጎችን መግደላቸውን አስታውቋል። ድርጅቱ ግድያው የተፈጸመው የማሊ ወታደሮች በተገኙበት እንደሆነ እና በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ድብደባና የቤት ማቃጠል እንደተፈጸመባቸው ገልጿል። የማሊ መንግስት እነዚህን የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶች በአፋጣኝ እንዲመረምር እና ተጠያቂዎችን ለህግ እንዲያቀርብ ድርጅቱ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa Human Rights Watch, gareen waraana Raashiyaa 'Africa Corps' jedhamu ganda Bombori kan Maalii keessatti ijoollee afur dabalatee namoota sagal ajjeesuusaa gabaaseera. Ajjeechaan kun kan raawwatame waraanni Maalii bakka sana osoo jiruu fi namoota nagaa reebuufi mana isaanii gubuu dabalatee miidhaan garagaraa akka irra ga'e ibsameera. Dhaabbatichi mootummaan Maalii gocha kana qoratee namoota yakka kana raawwatan seeratti akka dhiyeessu gaafateera.

title: France, Germany, UK and Italy condemn Israel's 'E1' West Bank settlement plan
english: France, Germany, the United Kingdom, and Italy have jointly criticized Israel's recent decision to move forward with new construction plans in the E1 area of the occupied West Bank. These four European nations declared that the development project is entirely unacceptable. This move highlights growing international opposition to settlement expansions in the region.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ፣ ጀርመን፣ ብሪታንያ እና ጣሊያን በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ በእስራኤል የታቀደውን አዲስ የግንባታ ፕሮጀክት በጋራ አውግዘዋል። አራቱ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ይህንን የሰፈራ ግንባታ ዕቅድ ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው በጋራ መግለጫቸው አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በክልሉ እየተስፋፋ ባለው የሰፈራ ግንባታ ላይ ዓለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞ እየጨመረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Faransaay, Jarman, Biriiteenii fi Xaaliyaaniin karoora Israa'eel naannoo Zoonii 'E1' kan Qabannoo Bahaa (West Bank) keessatti ijaarsa haaraa gaggeessuuf qabatte balaaleffataniiru. Biyyoonni Awurooppaa afuran kunneen karoora ijaarsa kana guutummaatti fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun bal'ina manneen jireenyaa naannichatti babal'isuu irratti mormiin idil-addunyaa dabalaa jiraachuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Hezbollah's Nawaf Moussawi: Only force can compel Israel to leave Lebanon
english: Hezbollah official Nawaf Moussawi stated that military action is the only way to remove Israeli forces from southern Lebanon. He argued that diplomatic discussions are ineffective because Lebanon currently lacks the necessary leverage to influence Israel. Consequently, he vowed that Hezbollah will persist in its armed struggle until the country is fully liberated from foreign troops.
amharic: የሂዝቦላህ ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን ናዋፍ ሙሳዊ እንደተናገሩት እስራኤልን ከደቡብ ሊባኖስ ለማስወጣት ብቸኛው መንገድ ወታደራዊ ኃይልን መጠቀም ነው። ንግግሮች ውጤታማ እንደማይሆኑ የገለጹት ባለሥልጣኑ፣ ሊባኖስ በእስራኤል ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር የሚያስችል አቅም እንደሌላት ተናግረዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት እስራኤል እስክትወጣ ድረስ የሂዝቦላህ የታጠቁት ኃይሎች ትግላቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Hizbollaah Nawaaf Muusawii akka jedhanitti, waraana Israa'eel kibba Libaanoos irraa baasuuf humna waraanaatti fayyadamuu qofatu furmaata dha. Mariin dippilomaasii bu'aa kan hin qabne ta'uu fi Libaanoos Israa'eel irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf humna gahaa akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Kanaafuu, hamma waraanni Israa'eel guutummaatti biyyattii gadi dhiisanii bahutti, Hizbollaah qabsoo isaa itti fufuu akka mirkaneessan ibsameera.

title: Hezbollah's Nawaf Moussawi: Only force can compel Israel to leave Lebanon
english: Senior Hezbollah official Nawaf Moussawi stated that armed resistance is the only way to remove Israeli forces from Lebanon, arguing that negotiations are ineffective without leverage. He defended Hezbollah's ongoing military actions as a necessary duty to counter occupation, despite the significant losses and widespread criticism the group has faced. Moussawi maintains that Israel is the root cause of the regional instability and will continue to target any group that seeks to challenge its presence.
amharic: የሂዝቦላህ ከፍተኛ አመራር ናዋፍ ሙሳዊ እስራኤልን ከሊባኖስ ማስወጣት የሚቻለው በድርድር ሳይሆን በትጥቅ ትግል ብቻ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። እርሳቸው እንደሚሉት ሂዝቦላህ የሚያካሂደው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በሊባኖስ ላይ የደረሰውን ወረራ ለመከላከል አስፈላጊ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የቡድኑ እንቅስቃሴ በሰፊው የሚተች ቢሆንም፣ ሙሳዊ የክልሉ አለመረጋጋት ዋና ምንጭ እስራኤል እንደሆነች እና ተቃውሞው እንደሚቀጥል አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoon Hizbullah Nawaf Mussaawii akka jedhanitti, humnoota Israa'el biyya Libaanoos keessaa baasuuf mala tokkichi marii osoo hin taane qabsoo hidhannooti. Mussaawiin akka jedhanitti, Hizbullah gocha waraanaa geggeessuun isaa biyyi isaanii weerara irraa akka ittistuuf dirqama ture. Hojiiwwan kun gidduu galeessatti mormii guddaa kan qaban ta'us, hoggantichi rakkoon naannichaa hundinuu weerara Israa'el irraa kan madde ta'uu fi qabsoon kunis itti fufu akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Bangladesh elects ruling party veteran Alamgir as president
english: Bangladesh's parliament has elected veteran politician Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as the country's new president. He was chosen through a vote following the resignation of the previous leader, Mohammed Shahabuddin, due to health issues. Although the presidency is primarily a ceremonial position, it serves as the formal head of state and commander-in-chief of the military.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ ፓርላማ አንጋፋውን ፖለቲከኛ ሚርዛ ፋክሩል ኢስላም አላምጊርን የአገሪቱ አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት አድርጎ መርጧል። የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት መሐመድ ሻሃቡዲን በጤና እክል ምክንያት በለቀቁት ቦታ ላይ በአባላት ድምፅ አሸናፊ በመሆን የተመረጡት አላምጊር፣ ስራውን በይፋ ይረከባሉ። ምንም እንኳን የፕሬዝዳንትነት ቦታው በአብዛኛው ስነስርዓታዊ ቢሆንም፣ የሀገሪቱ የመንግስት መሪ እና የጦር ኃይሎች ጠቅላይ አዛዥ በመሆን ያገለግላሉ።
oromo: Paarlaamaan Baangilaadesh siyaasaa beekamaa Mirzaa Faakruul Islaam Alaamgiir pirezidaantii biyyattii haaraa godhee filateera. Inni kan filatame pirezidaantiin kanaan dura ture Mohaammad Shaahabuddiin dhibee fayyaatiin hojii gadhiisuun isaatiin walqabatee bakka duwwaa ture guutuufi. Bakki pirezidaantummaa kun guddinaan sirna qofa kan qabu ta'us, inni mataa biyyaa fi ajajaa olaanaa raayyaa ittisa biyyaa ta'ee tajaajila.

title: Humanoid robots take centre stage in China-US tech race
english: China is prioritizing the development of humanoid robots to enhance industrial efficiency and gain a competitive edge in global technology. Companies in China are actively working to outperform their American counterparts in this rapidly growing sector. These advancements were prominently showcased at the recent World Robot Conference in Beijing, highlighting the intensified tech rivalry between the two nations.
amharic: ቻይና የምርታማነት አቅሟን ለማሳደግ እና በዓለም አቀፍ የቴክኖሎጂ ውድድር ተወዳዳሪ ለመሆን በሰው መሰል ሮቦቶች ግንባታ ላይ ትኩረት አድርጋለች። የቻይና ኩባንያዎች በዚህ መስክ ከአሜሪካ አቻዎቻቸው ጋር ከፍተኛ ፉክክር እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። በቅርቡ በቤጂንግ በተካሄደው የዓለም የሮቦት ኮንፈረንስ ላይ የታዩት እነዚህ የቴክኖሎጂ ውጤቶች፣ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የቴክኖሎጂ የበላይነት ፉክክር ይበልጥ አጉልተው አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Chaayinaan humna oomishtummaa ishee guddisuufi dorgommii teeknooloojii addunyaa irratti sadarkaa olaanaa argachuuf, robotoota bifa namaa qaban ijaaruurratti xiyyeeffachaa jirti. Dhaabbileen Chaayinaa damee kana keessatti guddinaafi dorgommii cimaa biyyoota Ameerikaa waliin taasisuu irratti argamu. Konfaransii Robotoota Addunyaa magaalaa Beejiingitti dhiheenya kana gaggeeffame irratti hojiileen kun ifatti kan dhiyaatan yoo ta'u, kunis dorgommii teeknooloojii biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: Swiss tourist jailed for insulting Bali’s sacred Day of Silence
english: A Swiss traveler has received a one-year prison sentence in Bali for disrespecting the island's holy Day of Silence. The individual shared videos on social media showing him outdoors during the restricted holiday and used offensive language toward local Hindu customs. Authorities took action against him for violating the sacred nature of the day through his online posts.
amharic: የስዊዘርላንድ ዜግነት ያለው አንድ ቱሪስት በባሊ ደሴት በሚከበረው የተቀደሰ የዝምታ ቀን ላይ ስድብ በመሰንዘሩ የአንድ ዓመት እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። ግለሰቡ በዝምታው ቀን በውጪ በመገኘቱና በሂንዱ ባህል ላይ የሚያንቋሽሹ አስተያየቶችን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመለጠፉ ነው ለዚህ ቅጣት የተዳረገው። ባለሥልጣናቱ ድርጊቱ ለሃይማኖታዊ በዓሉ ክብር የማይሰጥ በመሆኑ እርምጃ መውሰዳቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: ቱሪስት ስዊዘርላንድዊ tokko balii keessatti guyyaa kabajamoo ta'e 'guyyaa cal'iinsaa' irratti arrabsse jechuun hidhaa waggaa tokko itti murameera. Namichi kun guyyaa ayyaana kanaa ala bahuun fi aadaa Hinduudhaan walqabatee miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti jechoota miidhaa geessisan maxxansuun isaa komatameera. Aangeyyoonni guyyaa kana kabajuu dhabuu isaa hordofee tarkaanfii kana fudhataniiru.

title: Daily struggle for clean water and food takes a physical toll on Gaza kids
english: Children in Gaza are facing a severe humanitarian crisis, forcing them to spend their days searching for food and water instead of focusing on their education. Carrying heavy containers long distances is causing physical exhaustion and chronic pain for these young children. Families are devastated as they struggle to survive under these harsh conditions, which have left their children burdened with heavy responsibilities.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚኖሩ ሕጻናት ለምግብ እና ለንጹህ ውሃ በሚያደርጉት አድካሚ ፍለጋ ምክንያት ለከፍተኛ አካላዊ ስቃይ እየተዳረጉ ነው። እነዚህ ሕጻናት ከትምህርታቸው ይልቅ ውሃ ለመቅዳት ረጅም ርቀት በከባድ ዕቃ መጓዛቸው ለጤና ችግር እና ለድካም እየዳረጋቸው ይገኛል። ቤተሰቦችም ልጆቻቸው በዚህ እድሜያቸው ከባድ ኃላፊነት በመሸከማቸው ከፍተኛ የሀዘን እና የጭንቀት ስሜት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ijoolleen Gaaza keessa jiraatan hanqina nyaataa fi bishaanii hamaa mudachaa jiraniin, guyyaa isaanii barumsaaf oolchuun irra, bishaan barbaaduuf muddamaa jiru. Bishaan ba’uuf qodaa ulfaataa baachuun qaama isaanii irratti miidhaa fi dadhabbii cimaa geessisaa jira. Maatiin ijoollee isaanii umuriin isaanii osoo hin ga’in dirqama cimaa kana baachuu isaaniitiif gadda guddaa keessa jiru.

title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles as US-South Korea drills near end
english: North Korea launched over ten short-range ballistic missiles toward the sea shortly before the conclusion of joint military exercises between the United States and South Korea. Seoul officials condemned the act as a violation of UN resolutions and held an emergency meeting to address the threat. These launches occurred despite President Trump's recent efforts to scale back the military drills to encourage renewed diplomatic dialogue with Pyongyang.
amharic: ሰሜን ኮሪያ ከአሜሪካ እና ከደቡብ ኮሪያ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ መጠናቀቂያ በፊት ከአስር በላይ አጫጭር የባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎችን ወደ ባህር ተኩሳለች። የደቡብ ኮሪያ መንግስት ይህንን ድርጊት የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፀጥታው ምክር ቤት ውሳኔዎችን የጣሰ ነው ሲል አውግዞ፣ ስጋቱን ለመወያየት አስቸኳይ የደህንነት ስብሰባ ጠርቷል። ሚሳይሎቹ የተተኮሱት ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከሰሜን ኮሪያ ጋር ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለመጀመር ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን ለመቀነስ ጥረት እያደረጉ ባለበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Koreen Kaabaa guddina shaakala waraanaa Amerikaa fi Koriyaan Kibbaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa turee xumuramuu isaa dura, misaa'ela ballistic gabaabaa kudhan ol gara galaanaatti gadi lakkifteetti. Bulchiinsi Koriyaa Kibbaa gochi kun murtee mana maree nageenyaa UN kan cabsu ta'uu ibsuun, sodaa kana irratti mari'achuuf walgahii hatattamaa waameera. Misaa'eloonni kunneen kan dhukaafaman, pirezidaant Traamp Koriyaa Kaabaa waliin hariiroo diippiloomaasii haaromsuuf jecha shaakala waraanaa hir'isuuf yaalaa jiranitti.

title: Amid genocide in Gaza, why must Palestinian journalists uphold the illusion of neutrality?
english: The Israeli military recently killed Al Jazeera cameraman Ahmed Wishah in a drone strike, just months after his brother, also a journalist, was killed in a similar attack. Statistical reports indicate that the conflict in Gaza has become the deadliest environment for media workers in modern history, with Israel accounting for a significant portion of global journalist deaths. Critics argue that these targeted killings continue because Israel feels immune from international accountability for its actions against civilians and the press.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በአልጀዚራ ካሜራ ማን አህመድ ዊሻህ ላይ በፈጸመው ድሮን ጥቃት ጋዜጠኛው ህይወቱ አልፏል፤ ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተከሰተው ወንድሙና የሥራ ባልደረባው መሐመድ ዊሻህ በተመሳሳይ ጥቃት ከተገደሉ ወራት በኋላ ነው። በጋዛ ያለው ጦርነት ለጋዜጠኞች በታሪክ እጅግ አደገኛ እንደሆነ ጥናቶች ያሳያሉ፣ እስራኤልም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከሚገደሉ ጋዜጠኞች መካከል ከፍተኛውን ድርሻ ትይዛለች። የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ያለምንም ተጠያቂነት በጋዜጠኞች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን መቀጠላቸው ዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶችን እያሳሰበ ይገኛል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el gabaasaa fi kaameeraa mana hojii Al-Jazeera kan ta'e Ahmed Wishah xiyyaara malee fayyadamuun ajjeeseera; kunis obboleessi isaa Mohammed Wishah erga ajjeefame baatii muraasa booda kan raawwatame dha. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, waraanni Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru gaazexeessitootaaf addunyaa irratti bakka baay'ee yaaddessaa ta'ee jira, akkasumas Israa'el gaazexeessitoota addunyaa irratti ajjeefaman keessaa harka guddaa qabdi. Israa'el gocha ishee kanneen irratti itti gaafatamummaa tokko malee gaazexeessitoota irratti xiyyeeffachuu ishee itti fufuun ishee balaaleffannaa guddaa hordofsiiseera.

title: Yemeni government forces carry out dozens of ‘operations’ against Houthis
english: The Yemeni government military reported conducting 81 separate attacks against Houthi fighters over the last day. According to an army spokesperson, these strikes were a direct response to recent Houthi aggression. The government claims these actions successfully eliminated several rebel commanders and destroyed various pieces of their military hardware.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ጦር ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ 81 ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶችን መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል። የጦር ኃይሉ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት፣ እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በሁቲዎች ለተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች አጸፋዊ ምላሽ ናቸው። በተወሰደው እርምጃም በርካታ የሁቲ የጦር አዛዦች መገደላቸውንና ወታደራዊ ቁሳቁሶች መውደማቸውን መንግስት ገልጿል።
oromo: Humnooni mootummaa Yaman sa’aatii 24 darban keessatti haleellaa waraanaa 81 garee Huutii irratti gaggeessuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Dubbi himaan waraanaa akka jedhutti, haleellaan kun tarkaanfii deebii haleellaa gareen Huutii isaan irratti fudhateef kenname dha. Tarkaanfii kanaanis ajootonni garee kanaa muraasni ajjeefamuu fi meeshaaleen waraanaa isaanii barbadaa'uu mootummaan ibseera.

title: US targets Hezbollah with fresh sanctions
english: The United States is implementing new sanctions against Hezbollah by re-designating the group as a global terrorist entity. This action specifically highlights the group's close ties to the Iranian government and its military forces. By taking this step, the U.S. aims to exert further pressure on the organization due to its support of Iran's regional agenda.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ሂዝቦላህን እንደ ዓለም አቀፍ አሸባሪ ቡድን እንደገና በመሰየም አዲስ ማዕቀብ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። ይህ እርምጃ ቡድኑ ከኢራን መንግስት እና ከወታደራዊ ሃይሎቹ ጋር ያለውን የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ለማሳየት ያለመ ነው። አሜሪካ ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰነችው ቡድኑ የኢራንን የክልል ፍላጎቶች በማስፈጸም ረገድ ያለውን ሚና በመቃወም ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa garee Hizbullah akka garee shororkeessaa addunyaatti irra deebi’ee moggaasuudhaan ergaa haaraa ergeera. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo cimaa gareen kun mootummaa Iraan fi humnoota waraana ishee waliin qabu ifa baasa. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte, gareen kun fedhii siyaasaa Iraan naannichatti akka raawwatu gargaaruu isaa mormuufi.

title: Como mayor bans 'beasts' in city centre after being hit by bike
english: The mayor of Como, Italy, has implemented a ban on riding bicycles in the city's historic center after being struck by an electric bike. Starting in September, cyclists must walk their bikes through approximately 30 streets to improve pedestrian safety. This decision is part of broader new traffic regulations aimed at managing tourist activity and limiting vehicular access in the town.
amharic: የጣሊያን ከተማ ኮሞ ከንቲባ በኤሌክትሪክ ብስክሌት አደጋ ከገጠማቸው በኋላ በከተማዋ ታሪካዊ ማዕከል ውስጥ ብስክሌት መንዳትን ከልክለዋል። ከሴፕቴምበር ወር ጀምሮ የእግረኞችን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ብስክሌተኞች በተመረጡ 30 መንገዶች ላይ ብስክሌታቸውን በመግፋት ብቻ ማለፍ ይጠበቅባቸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የቱሪስት እንቅስቃሴን ለመቆጣጠር እና የትራፊክ መጨናነቅን ለመቀነስ የወጣው አዲሱ የከተማዋ የትራፊክ ደንብ አካል ነው።
oromo: Kantiibaan magaalaa Koomoo kan Xaaliyaanii, erga miidhaan baayiskilii elektirikiin irra gahee booda, giddugala magaalaa keessatti baayiskilii oofuu dhorkaniiru. Hagayya booda irraa eegalee, nageenya namoota miilaan deemanii eeguuf jedhamee, namoonni baayiskilii fayyadaman daandiiwwan 30 ta'an irratti baayiskilii isaanii dhiibanii akka darban dirqama ta'a. Murteen kun to'annoo tuuristii fi daandiiwwan magaalaa irratti sochii konkolaataa murteessuuf seera tiraafikaa haaraa bahe keessaa tokko dha.

title: Spanish police evict hundreds of migrants from Ceuta beach to shelters
english: Spanish authorities have begun clearing out hundreds of migrants who had been living in temporary camps on a beach in Ceuta. These individuals arrived after crossing the border from Morocco in large numbers last July. The police are now relocating them to official government shelters to provide them with proper accommodation and support.
amharic: የስፔን ፖሊስ በሴኡታ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በጊዜያዊ መጠለያ ሲኖሩ የነበሩ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞችን እያወጣ ነው። እነዚህ ስደተኞች ባለፈው ሐምሌ ወር ከሞሮኮ ጋር በሚዋሰነው ድንበር በኩል በብዛት የገቡ ናቸው። ባለሥልጣናቱ ስደተኞቹን የተሻለ እንክብካቤ እና መጠለያ ለማግኘት ወደሚችሉባቸው የመንግሥት ማዕከላት እያዘዋወሯቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Poolisiin Ispeen godina Se'uutaa keessatti qarqara galaanaatti buufata yeroo ijaaranii turan baqattoota dhibbaan lakkaa'aman gara iddoo dhugaatti geessuu jalqabaniiru. Baqattoonni kun baatii Adooleessaa darbe daangaa Morookoo irraa lolaanii seenan turan. Poolisiin yeroo ammaa baqattoota kana bakka qubannaa fi kunuunsi gaariin jiruun mootummaan qophesseefitti geessaa jira.

title: Syria detains policeman over death of White Helmets rescuer hit in custody
english: A Syrian police officer has been detained and faces potential prosecution following the death of a former White Helmets volunteer, Mohammad Ghamira. Ghamira, who suffered from hemophilia, died from a brain hemorrhage after being slapped by the officer while in custody. Despite warnings about his medical condition, the authorities failed to protect him, leading to public outcry regarding ongoing human rights concerns under the new government.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፖሊስ መኮንን የቀድሞ የነጭ ኮፍያ (White Helmets) በጎ ፈቃደኛ የነበሩትን መሀመድ ጋሚራን ሞት ተከትሎ በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ጋሚራ በሂሞፊሊያ በሽታ ይያዙ የነበረ ሲሆን በእስር ቤት ውስጥ በፖሊስ መኮንኑ በጥፊ ከተመቱ በኋላ በአንጎል ውስጥ የደም መፍሰስ አጋጥሟቸው ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ስለጤንነታቸው ሁኔታ አስቀድሞ ለባለስልጣናት ቢነገሩም ጥበቃ ባለማድረጋቸው ምክንያት በአዲሱ መንግስት ስር የሚፈጸሙ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶች በህዝቡ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ቁጣ ቀስቅሰዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin biyya Siriyaa tokko du'a namoota 'White Helmets' keessatti tajaajilaa turanii kan ta'an Mohammad Ghamira hordofee qabamee jira. Ghamira dhukkuba dhiiga dhiiguu hin dhaabne (hemophilia) qaba kan ture yoo ta'u, hidhamtee keessatti poolisichaan reebamee dhiigni sammuu isaa keessatti yaa'ee lubbuun isaa darbeera. Haalli fayyaa isaa beekamtii keessa akka galu himamee osoo jiruu poolisichi tarkaanfii fudhachuun isaa, mootummaa haaraa kanaanis mirgi namoomaa kabajamuu dhabuu isaa irratti mormii guddaa uumee jira.

title: Exclusive: UK condemns 'abhorrent' Ben Gvir comments on killing Palestinians
english: The British government has strongly criticized Israeli Minister Itamar Ben Gvir for suggesting that dozens of Palestinians should be killed in Gaza every night. Officials labeled these remarks as dehumanizing and repulsive, noting that the minister called for targeting individuals even if they do not pose an immediate threat. Ben Gvir's comments have drawn significant international backlash for their inflammatory nature regarding the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት የእስራኤሉ ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር በጋዛ በየምሽቱ ከ30 እስከ 40 ፍልስጤማውያን መገደል አለባቸው በማለታቸው ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አሰምቷል። የብሪታንያ ባለስልጣናት የእስራኤሉ ሚኒስትር የሰጡት አስተያየት ሰብአዊነት የጎደለው እና አጸያፊ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ሚኒስትሩ ምንም አይነት ስጋት ባይፈጥሩም በሰዎች ላይ ጥቃት እንዲፈጸም ጥሪ ማቅረባቸው በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ትችት አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Biriiteen ministira nageenya biyyoolessaa Israa'el Itaamaar Ben Gwiir, Gizaatti guyyaa guyyaan namoonni Filisxeemii 30 hanga 40 ta'an akka ajjeefaman yaadachuu isaanii balleessee jira. Aantotni Biriiteen ibsa kana kanneen namummaa irraa gargar baasan fi kan nama suukanneessan jedhaniiru. Ministirichi namoota balaa hin taane irrattillee tarkaanfiin akka fudhatamu waamicha dhiyeessuun isaanii mormii cimaa biyyoolessaa guutuu irratti kaaseera.

title: British activist Anas Altikriti questions UAE surveillance operation
english: British activist Anas Altikriti received a police warning that his life was in imminent danger, though authorities provided no specific details at the time. Years later, leaked documents revealed that the United Arab Emirates had conducted a detailed surveillance operation against him, tracking his personal life and daily routines. Altikriti is now questioning whether British authorities were aware of this foreign espionage on their soil and why they failed to adequately protect him.
amharic: የብሪታንያው አክቲቪስት አናስ አልቲክሪቲ ህይወታቸው ለአደጋ የተጋለጠ መሆኑን የሚገልጽ የፖሊስ ማስጠንቀቂያ ቀደም ብለው ደርሷቸው ነበር፣ ነገር ግን ባለስልጣናት በወቅቱ ምንም አይነት ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም ነበር። ከዓመታት በኋላ የወጡ ሚስጥራዊ ሰነዶች የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬትስ እሳቸውን ለመከታተል ዝርዝር የሰላይነት ዘመቻ አካሂዳ እንደነበር አጋልጠዋል። አልቲክሪቲ አሁን የብሪታንያ ባለስልጣናት ስለዚሁ የውጭ ሰላይነት ድርጊት ያውቁ እንደነበር እና ለምን እንደማይከላከልላቸው ጥያቄ እያነሱ ነው።
oromo: Aktiivistiin Biriitaaniyaa Anas Altikriiti lubbuun isaa balaa keessa akka jiru poolisiin akeekkachiisee ture, garuu yeroo sanatti qaamni mootummaa bal'inaan ibsuu dhabe. Waggoota booda, ragaaleen dhangala'an akka ibsanitti, Mootummaan Waldaa Emireetota Arabaa (UAE) sochii isaa hordofuuf ergamtoota bobbaasuu isaa saaxileera. Altikriiti ammayyuu, qaamni mootummaa Biriitaaniyaa waa'ee hordoffii biyya alaa kanaa beekuu fi maaliif akka isa hin eegne gaaffii kaasaa jira.

title: One geography, two states: Saudi Arabia’s security approach to Sudan
english: Saudi Arabia views the stability and unity of Sudan as critical to its own national security due to their shared Red Sea geography. To formalize this bond, both nations established the Saudi-Sudanese Coordination Council to address regional security and geopolitical challenges. This partnership is deeply rooted in long-standing historical, cultural, and social ties that have maintained a peaceful relationship between the two countries for decades.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የሱዳን መረጋጋት እና አንድነት በቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ለሚገኘው የራሷ ብሔራዊ ደህንነት ወሳኝ እንደሆነ ታምናለች። ይህንን የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ይበልጥ ለማጠናከር ሁለቱ ሀገራት በክልሉ ደህንነት እና በጂኦፖለቲካዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ በጋራ ለመስራት የሚያስችል የሳዑዲ-ሱዳን የተቀናጀ ምክር ቤት አቋቁመዋል። ይህ አጋርነት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ለረጅም ዓመታት ሲኖር በቆየው ታሪካዊ፣ ባህላዊ እና ማህበራዊ ትስስር ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan tasgabbii fi tokkummaan Sudaan nageenya biyya ishee fi naannoo garba diimaa eeguuf baay'ee barbaachisaa akka ta'e amanti. Walitti dhufeenya kana caalaatti cimsuuf, biyyoonni lameen waloon dhimma nageenyaa fi siyaasa naannichaa irratti akka hojjetan 'Council' waliin hojii dhaabanii jiru. Walta'iinsi kun hariiroo seenaa, aadaa fi hawaasummaa waggoota dheeraaf biyyoota lameen gidduu ture irratti hundaa'a.

title: Deadly Russian missile barrage hits Kyiv in hours-long overnight attack
english: Russia launched a massive overnight aerial attack on Kyiv and surrounding areas using a combination of drones, ballistic missiles, and cruise missiles. The assault struck 28 different locations throughout Ukraine, resulting in at least 16 fatalities and numerous injuries. This hours-long bombardment marks a significant escalation in the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢዋ ባሉ አካባቢዎች ላይ በድሮኖች፣ በባለስቲክ እና በክሩዝ ሚሳይሎች የታጀበ ሰፊ የአየር ላይ ጥቃት አድርሳለች። ጥቃቱ በዩክሬን ውስጥ በ28 የተለያዩ ቦታዎች ላይ የተፈጸመ ሲሆን፣ በዚህም ቢያንስ 16 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ ብዙዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ይህ ለበርካታ ሰዓታት የዘለቀው ጥቃት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ባለው ጦርነት ላይ ከፍተኛ መባባስን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Raashiyaan magaalaa Kiyivii fi naannawa ishee irratti haleellaa gama samii, kan jedhaman rookeetii fi xiyyaara malee balali'an fayyadamuun raawwatteetti. Haleellaan kun bakka 28 yoo rukutu, namoota 16 ol ta'an lubbuun kan darban yoo ta'u, hedduun isaanii immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan sa'aatii dheeraaf itti fufe kun, waraana biyyoota lamaanii keessatti dhiibbaa guddaa fi hammeenya mul'isu ta'eera.

title: Gunmen seize tanker off Yemen amid resurgence of Somali piracy
english: Six armed individuals have hijacked the tanker Seamull, also known as SIBU 1, off the coast of Yemen and are currently forcing the vessel toward Somalia. This incident highlights a growing trend of Somali piracy, which has seen a significant increase after years of being largely inactive. International authorities are now investigating the situation as concerns mount over the safety of the crew and the security of this vital global shipping route.
amharic: ስድስት የታጠቁ ሰዎች የሴሙል የተባለ መርከብን በየመን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በመቆጣጠር ወደ ሶማሊያ እንዲያመራ እያደረጉት ይገኛል። ይህ ጥቃት ባለፉት አስር ዓመታት ተዳክሞ የነበረው የሶማሊያ የባህር ላይ ወንበዴነት ዳግም እያገረሸ መሆኑን ያሳያል። የዓለም አቀፍ የባህር ደህንነት አካላት ስለ መርከበኞቹ ደህንነት እና በዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ መስመር ላይ ስላለው ስጋት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Namoonni hidhatan ja'a ta'an doonii boba'aa 'Seamull' jedhamtu qarqara Yemenitti qabachuun gara Somaaliyaatti akka imaltu dirqisiisaniiru. Gochi kun kutaalee Somaaliyaa keessatti yakki saaminsa galaana keessaa waggoota hedduu booda deebi'ee akka hammaate agarsiisa. Abbootiin taayitaa idil-addunyaa waa'ee nageenya hojjettoota dooniichaa fi tasgabbii daandii daldalaa kanaa ilaalchisee qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Can US, Middle Eastern powers unite Libya 15 years after Gaddafi overthrow?
english: Fifteen years after the fall of Muammar Gaddafi, international powers including the United States, Egypt, and Turkey are working to reconcile Libya's two competing governments. The country remains fractured between the UN-backed administration in Tripoli and an eastern authority supported by Khalifa Haftar's forces. These diplomatic efforts aim to end years of instability and restore national unity to the oil-rich nation.

title: Landslide kills 13 at illegal gold mine in Colombia’s southwest
english: A deadly landslide at an unauthorized gold mine in Colombia's Narino region has left 13 people dead and seven others wounded. The collapse was triggered by active mining operations, which occurred shortly after the nation was struck by a powerful earthquake. Local authorities are currently managing the aftermath of this tragedy amidst ongoing disaster recovery efforts across the country.

title: How China and Russia could hobble Trump’s plans to isolate Iran
english: President Trump has launched an aggressive campaign to cripple Iran's economy by threatening sanctions against any nation that supports it. However, experts believe these efforts may fail because Russia is already largely disconnected from the U.S. financial system and China has shown a willingness to ignore American mandates. Successfully isolating Iran would require global cooperation that the current U.S. strategy lacks, making it difficult for the administration to achieve its goals.

title: Iran condemns new US sanctions, calls them 'economic terrorism'
english: The Iranian government has strongly criticized the latest economic sanctions imposed by the United States, labeling them as a form of economic terrorism that harms everyday citizens. President Trump recently warned that any nation assisting Iran will face severe consequences, including international isolation. Despite these threats, Tehran stated that the new measures will not stop them from protecting their national sovereignty and interests.

title: Israeli strikes hit southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces have launched a series of attacks across southern Lebanon. Air strikes were conducted in the Bint Jbeil district, while artillery fire hit areas within the Tyre district. These reports were confirmed by Lebanon's official news agency as regional tensions remain high.

title: ‘We are starving’: Palestinians besieged by settlers in West Bank homes run out of food
english: Families in the West Bank town of Qusra have been trapped in their homes by Israeli settlers for 12 days, leading to a critical food shortage. Although Israeli soldiers initially arrived at the site, they have since blocked aid deliveries from reaching the affected families. Currently, the residents are struggling to survive as their limited supplies run out and previously delivered food begins to spoil.

title: Turkey, Egypt, Qatar condemn Israeli attacks on Gaza
english: Turkey, Egypt, and Qatar have issued a joint statement strongly condemning recent Israeli military actions in Gaza. The three nations urged Israel to honor its ceasefire commitments and avoid any behavior that might worsen regional tensions. They warned that these strikes threaten ongoing international peace negotiations and efforts to permanently end the conflict.

title: Assad officer extradited to Syria on war crimes charges for first time
english: Lebanon has extradited former Syrian Major General Adel Issa to face trial for war crimes, marking the first such handover since the fall of Bashar al-Assad's regime. Issa is accused of murder and torture committed while leading military forces in Deir Ezzor. This action follows a formal request from Syria’s new leadership, who are actively pursuing legal cases against numerous former officials involved in the civil war.

title: Governments brace for historic El Nino impacts on global weather extremes
english: Global governments are bracing for extreme weather conditions caused by a powerful El Nino event, which is expected to intensify later this year.
